chos rje phag mo gru pas maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ sku gsum du bstan pa lags sam zhus pas/ dge bshes khams pa ngas sems can re re'i mdun du sku brgya brgya ston kyang nus gsung*/d chos rje 'bri gung dus gcig la sku bzhir bstan pa yin/ du gnyer ba ni ye shes kyi spangs bya nyon mongs pa bcom pa'i brda/ yab yum zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa ni ye shes tha mi dad pa'i brda/ yab kyi phyag dang po gnyis kyis yum la 'khyud pa ni ye shes kyi chos nyid dbyings yul du byed dgos pa'i brda/ phyag g.yon dang pos dril bu bsnams pa ni rten 'brel gyi chos thams cad rang bzhin med par shes pa'i brda/ g.yas dang pos rdo rje rtse lnga bsnams pa ni ye shes lnga rgyud la skyes pa'i brda/ phyag bcu gnyis ni rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs las ldog pa'i brda/ phyag 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon bsnams pa ni/ 'gro ba'i gti mug 'joms pa'i brda/ g.yon gyi gsum pas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bsnams pa ni byang chub kyi sems dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i brda/ g.yon gyi bzhi pa na thod pa khrag gis bkang ba bsnams pa ni thugs rje dang stong pa zung du 'jug pa'i brda/ g.yon pa lnga pa na rdo rje zhags pa bsnams pa ni stong pa yang dag pa'i zhags pas sems can 'khor bar mi stong bar tshur sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gugs pa'i brda/ g.yon drug pa na tshangs pa'i mgo bo bsnams pa ni thar pa thams cad kyi mchog sangs rgyas thob dgos pa'i brda/ g.yas gsum na ḍā ma ru bsnams pa ni skye ba med pa'i sgras sangs rgyas rnams sems can gyi don la skul ba'i brda/ g.yas bzhi pa na dgra n bsnams pa ni lus ngag yid gsum gyi nyes pa bshags nas rgyun gcod pa'i brda/ g.yas lnga pa na gri gug bsnams pa ni dngos po dang dngos po med pa'i rnam par rtog pa thams cad rgyun gcod pa'i brda/ g.yas drug pa rtse gsum bsnams pa ni 'dod khams kyi srid pa dang*/

gzugs khams kyi srid pa dang*/ gzugs med kyi khams kyi srid pa gcad nas stong par sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i brda/ zhabs g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa ni chos thams cad dang po nas med par rtogs pa'i brda/ zhabs g.yas pas 'jigs byed mnan pa ni rtag par lta ba'i mtha' las grol nas rtag par mi lta ba'i brda/ zhabs g.yon pas dus mtshan ma mnan pa ni chad par mi lta ba'i brda/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs ni/ byams pa dang stong par 'gro ba'i zhe sdang 'joms pa'i brda/ phyag gdub dpung rgyan ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ mgul rgyan tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i brda/ rna cha gdub 'khor bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ dbu rgyan dang 'khor lo nor bu brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ mchod phyir thog dang sku rags dang 'og pag zhabs dub gsum bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ thal ba'i rdul gyi gos pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa rdzogs pa'i brda/ mtshan bzang sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu 'gro ba dang bas yid 'phrogs nas chos la 'dzud pa'i brda'o// mi mgo rlon pa lnga bcu ni ā li kā li lnga bcu/ don dam dang kun rdzob kyi chos thams cad de gnyis kyis ston pa'i brda/ nyi ma'i gdan ni ma rig pa'i 'dam rdzab bskams nas/ byang chub kyi myu gu smin par byed pa'i brda/ sna tshogs paV dang nyi ma'i gdan ni 'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos pa'i brda/ bcom ldan 'das ma dang dpa' bo rnal 'byor thams cad zhal gcig tu 'dug pa ni stong pa nyid gcig pu yin pa'i brda/ skra grol ba ni chos thams cad gdod ma nas grol ba'i brda/ na bza' med pa sgrib pa med pa'i brda/ sku mdog dmar mor 'dug pa ni bde ba chen po yab la chags pa dang*/ thugs rjes sems can la chags pa'i brda/ gzhon nu ma lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu 'dug pa ni bde ba chen pos gang ba'i brda'o// rgyan la sogs pa rnams yab dang mthun pas yab bzhin shes par bya'o// de thams cad kyis lus ngag dge ba la bkol ba dang*/

dang po nas stong pa yin pas zung 'jug gcig pur ngo sprod du shar ba yin no// nam mkha'i steng gi sems can rnams 'dul ba la thugs kyi 'khor lo byon/ sa steng gi sems can rnams 'dul ba la gsung gi 'khor lo byon/ sa 'og gi sems can rnams 'dul ba la sku'i 'khor lo byon/ sna tshogs pa 'dul ba la dam tshig gi 'khor lo/ sna tshogs dang bde ba chen po'i lha tshogs su bstan nas dran pa nyer bzhag la sogs pa byang chub kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun gyis khrid nas ye shes ngo sprod/ sa phyed dang bcu gsum gyi dus su sangs rgyas gcig pur bstan nas chos sku yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin gcig pur ngo sprod/ bden pa bzhis 'dul ba rnams la phyag rgya bzhi bstan nas ngo sprod/ bden pa gnyis 'dul ba rnams la zhabs gnyis su bstan nas gsang sngags brda gcig pus gdod ma nas sangs rgyas grub nas yod par ngo sprod pa yin no// gang la mos pa'i lha dang bla mar bstan nas ye shes ngo sprod pa yin no// sems can thams cad byang chub sems dpa' gcig pus 'dul na byang chub sems dpa' gcig pur bstan nas sangs rgyas ngo sprod/ nyan thos kyis 'dul ba la nyan thos su bstan nas ུra ston/ mes 'dul ba la mer ston/ rlung gi 'dul ba la rlung du ston/ nam mkhas 'dul ba la nam mkha' bstan nas sems skye med du ngo sprod/ de bzhin du gnyis pa la gsum par ston/ gsum pa la bzhi par ston/ bzhi pa lnga par ston/ lnga pa la drug par ston/ drug pa la bdun par ston/ bdun pa la brgyad par ston/ brgyad pa la dgu par ston/ dgu pa la bcu par ston/ sa bcu pa la sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad du bstan nas shes bya'i sgrib pa spong*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa dag nas chos sku gcig tu gyur nas sangs rgyas so// rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa 'byung*/ yun 'khor ba ma stong bar du 'byung*/ ched du bya ba thams cad dang po nas sangs rgyas pa yin pa yin par ngo sprod pa dang*/

sangs rgyas la 'god pa gcig pu'i ched du mdzad/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad sangs rgyas la 'god pa'i rgyu 'bras thams cad sku lus gcig rgyan la sogs pa rgyan dang cha lugs re re 'am/ sku cig gis kyang sems can thams cad dang po nas sangs rgyas yin par ston pa dang*/ bde ba dang stong pa zung 'jug yin par ston pa dang*/ dpal rnam par snang mdzad la zhing khams thams cad du skus khyab pa'i brdar rgyan cha lugs yod pa bzhin no// bcom ldan 'das rnam par snang mdzad de bskal pa grangs med pa la thugs ye shes gcig pur shar ba'i rgyu 'bras yin no// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi dpung pa las 'jug pa byang chub sems kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u ste bco brgyad pa'o// //de nas 'jug pa de don dam du na 'phos nas/ bskal pa grangs med phyi ma la bcom ldan 'das bskal pa grangs med phyi ma'i dus su byang chub sems dpa' bram ze'i khye'u sprin du gyur pa'i dus su don dam gyi smon pa skye ste/ 'khor 'das kyi bzung 'dzin thams cad stong par 'dug pas/ sems can thams cad stong par rtog med cig tu song na dga' ba la snyam pa de don dam gyi smon pa yin/ de nas don dam pa stong pa gcig pur thugs bskyed nas/ sa brgyad kyi rtogs pa skyes bu dbang po lnga dang rnam par shes pa tshogs brgyad do// stong pa gcig pur 'jug pa de don dam gyi 'jug pa yin/ de'i 'bras bu don dam gyi don dam ni/ rang nyid sgom med du song nas 'khor 'das dang snod bcud thams cad stong par rtog med cig tu song nas/ stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med/ byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med/ 'khor 'das dbyer med nam mkha' blo 'das zhig tu song ba de don dam yin no// nam mkha' de chos sku yin no// gdul byas gsol ba gang btab 'byung ba de sems can gdul bya des sems ma rtogs bar du yon tan ster ba de sprul sku yin no// gdul bya'i sems rtogs nas ye shes gcig pur ngo sprod pa longs sku yin no// de gsum gcig par stong nyid rgyu 'bras dbyer med pa de ngo bo nyid kyi sku yin no// chos sku nam mkha' stong pa ni lha'i nor bu rin po che dang 'dra'o// gzugs sku gnyis ni de 'jug pa'i snod dang 'dra'o// gzugs sku gnyis la mos pa de la mos pa dang 'dra'o// gzugs sku gnyis chos sku rtogs par byed pa'i thabs las grub pa yin no// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gyi bye ma snyed tshangs pa'i gnas man chad byung bur bkang nas bskal pa gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi bar du dad pas mchod pa lhag ma ma lus par byas pa bas/

sems can thams cad stong pa nyid chos sku thob par bya ba'i phyir/ chos sku stong pa nyid thun cig bsgom/ kha 'don byed dam yi ger 'dri ba'i bsod nams kyi brgya'i char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ stong gi char yang*/ brgya stong gi char yang*/ bye ba'i char yang*/ bye ba brgya stong gi char yang*/ bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong gi char yang nye bar mi 'gro/ dper yang mi 'gro/ chos kun gdod ma nas chos sku byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa rtog med gcig pu'i ngang la btang bar bya'o// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi'i dpung pa las/ don dam sems bskyed kyi 'bras bu bstan pa'i le'u ste bcu dgu pa'o/ //de ltar smon pa byang chub kyi sems tshad med pa de'i 'bras bu longs sku'i rten can gyi 'bras bu sprul sku'i bstan pa gnas lugs dang*/ 'jug pa byang chub kyi sems tshad med pas de'i 'bras bu longs sku'i bstan pa rgya dang yul tshad med par bstan pa dang*/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyis 'khor 'das ma skyes pa nam mkhar sems bskyed pa de'i 'bras bu 'khor 'das thams cad nam mkha'i yon tan phrin las can du song ba rgyun chad med pa yin no// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi'i dpung pa las gnas tshul bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu pa'o// //'jug pa'i bsngo ba bya ba ni/ thos pa ri rab tsam byas pa'i shes rab yod kyang*/ sgom pa'i shes rab nyung 'bru tsam la 'dud dgos/ thos pa rgya mtsho tsam byas kyang*/ nyams myong ba glang gi smig rjes tsam la 'dud dgos/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'ong gis thos pa mtha' med pa byas pa'i dge bshes yin yang*/ chos rje rin po che sgom chen pa gcig la 'dud dgos pa 'byung ba yin/ thos pas dregs pa'i bla ma ngad phu ba yang chos rje la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/ 'dul 'dzin gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen dpal thag ma bas kyang chos rje la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/

rgyud mkhan dpal shi ri phug pa dang*/ bla ma dus 'khor ba dang*/ dge bshes jo nubs la sogs pas kyang chos rje sgom chen pa zhig la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/ do ha mkhan po bla ma bal pos kyang chos rje la 'dud pas grub pa thob pa yin/ chos rje phag mo gru pa brgya dang bcu bzhi'i chos shes pa zhig gis chos rje sgam po pa sgom pa zhig la 'dud dgos par byung ba yin/ ma sgom par bslab pa gcig pus 'chi tsa na 'gyod pa skye ba rngog blo ldan shes rab lta bu 'byung ba yin/ phal chen las/ ji ltar long ba ri mo mkhan// ri mo legs par bris lags kyang*// rang gi mthong bar mi 'gyur bas// ma bsgom chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar 'on pa rol mo mkhan// rol mo legs par dkrol lags kyang*// rang gis thos par mi 'gyur bas// ma bsgom chos kyang de bzhin no// ji ltar bu ram mngar ba'i ro// brjod pas ro ni mi myong ste// myangs pas ro ni myong bar 'gyur// de bzhin stong pa nyid kyi sgra// thos pas ro ni mi myong ste// bsgoms pas ro ni myong bar 'gyur// zhes gsung*/ de nas byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dbye ba med pa'i stong pa nyid de dang po thos dgos/ de nas ma brjed par dgos/ de nas sgom dgos pas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen bong gi+ugs 'dzin pa'i ri khrod pa/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje rin po che 'bri khung pa'i chos 'khor gsum gyi snying po byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bla na med pa'i byang chub sgrub pa 'di bris pas/ 'gal ba dang 'khrul pa byung na bla ma dkon mchog la bzod par gsol lo/ gegs sel bdud rtsi dpung pa 'di gsungs pa'i bsod nams kyis mtshon nas/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig

ces pa'am yid la mi byed pa'i ngang nas bsngo ba byed pa des mjug gi don bstan pa'o// theg pa chen po'i tshul gegs sel bdud rtsi dpung pa las/ mjug gi don zhus lugs dang*/ bzod gsol dang*/ bsngo ba bstan pa'i le'u ste nyi shu gcig pa'o// de ltar klad kyi don shis par brjod pa dang*/ mchod par brjod pa dang*/ bshad par dam bca' ba dang gsum gyis klad kyi don bstan nas/ gzhung gi don la/ rgyu mtshan nyid pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa ltar nyams su blangs pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi theg pa ltar nyams su blangs pa gnyis kyis/ gzhung gi don bstan to// chos kyi zhus lugs dang*/ 'gal 'khrul bzod par gsol ba dang*/ byang chub tu bsngo ba dang gsum gyi mjug gi don bstan to// de la rgyas par le'i nyi shu

821) ༄// zhal gyi gdams pa bdud rtsi dri ma med pa'i snying po// oṃ swasti/ rje lhun grub 'od gsal chos kyi sku// zung 'jug bde chen lhan cig skyes// mi zad sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /mnyam med rin po che la 'dud// rje kun tu snang ba bkod pa'i dpal// rgya chen dbang phyug chos kyi mdzod// spros med zhi ba'i ngang la bzhugs// bde gshegs chos kyi rje la 'dud// rje byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin nyid// tshogs gnyis mthar phyin rtag pa'i sku// kun mkhyen ye shes kun gzigs pa// brtse chen 'gro ba'i mgon la 'dud/ /e ma ngo mtshar rmad kyi gtam// 'dzam gling gangs can bod yul dbus// phyogs bcu'i zhing nas 'dus pa yi// rgyas sras rgya mtsho brten pa'i gnas// 'og min dpal gyi 'bri gung gi// rin chen chos kyi pho brang na// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// mi 'jigs seṅge'i khri steng du// mi g.yo mnyam gzhag lhan ne bzhugs// dri med zhal gyi dkyil 'khor gyi// mtshan mchog dung gi tshems bar nas// ljags kyi dbang po brkyang mdzad de// zab cing rgya che dam pa'i chos// tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad gsung*// //thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad gang du don 'dus pa dang snying por gyur pa gang yin snyam spangs pa'i zhing*// lta ba log pas dkrugs pa'i gnas// snyigs ma lnga ldan 'jig rten 'dir// gzigs pa rnam pa lngas gzigs te// yum sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i lhums su zhugs// li±ི yi ni nags tshal du// skyes bu gzhon nu bltams pa dang*// gzhon nu rol rtsed mdzad pa dang*// btsun mo'i 'khor dgyes rol ba ste// nyi shu rtsa dgu khab tu bzhugs// grong khyer ser skya'i sgo bzhi ru// rgas nad 'chi ba gzigs pa yi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// thugs skyo ba skyes nas rab tu gshegs// nai rañdzābla ma la// mi mjed bdag po tshangs chen gyis// bla med chos kyi 'khor lo de// bskor bar bskul ma rgya chen btab// wa ra ṇā sir gshegs nas kyang*// drang srong lhung ba'i gnas su byon// thub pas lnga sde bzang po la// bka' bden pa bzhi yi 'khor lo bskor// der gdul bya smin dang grol mdzad cing*// rim gyis rgyu zhing gshegs pa las// rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du byon// bya rgod phung po'i ri bo la// bka' mtshan ma med pa'i 'khor lo bskor// mnyan yod gnas dang bad sa la// gnas khyad du 'phags pa du ma dang*// rtsa mchog grong khyer la sogs par// nges don gtan la phab pa yi// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor mdzad pas// dpag med gdul bya'i skye bo rnams// byang chu'agro ba'i mgon po rin po che// mnyam med bla ma'i zhal snga nas// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma lus thams cad rang gi sems// sems skye med nam mkha' lta bu zhes// yang dang yang du gsungs pa 'di// thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa'i// gnad dang don gyi snying po yin// gzhi rtsa ba bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems// de'i rjes 'brangs khyad du 'dzin pa'i chos// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// dog dang mi dog gang gis kyang*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// bsgral bar nus pa ma yin te// srid pa gsum 'dir rgyun du 'khor// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems de nyid// skye ba med par rtogs pa'i tshe// 'du byed 'khor ba'i 'byung khungs la// nyams dang lhung da'i byang chub mchog la bkod// 'di bdag rkyen chos kyi dbyings nyid dang*// gzhan rkyen sems can ma zad tshe// yang dag rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// sku gsung thugs nyid bsam mi khyab// de mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin// rang sems shes rab pha rol phyin// 'khor 'das yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// don dam phyag rgya chen po de// bla ma'i mos gus kyis rtogs pa yin// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i rgyu// byang chub sems su nges pa'i phyir// ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// don du byang chub sems bskyed pas// bsam pa de yi lus su 'gyur// byang chub sems kyi mi mthun phyogs// 'gal rkyen spang zhing mthun rkyen bsgrub// 'bras bu stobs bcu thob pa de// tshul khrims rnam par dag pa yin// byang chub sems gnyis tshul khrims dang*// chos rnam pa gsum po 'di nyid las// zab pa'i dam chos bdag la med// khyod kyis 'di gsum bzung zhig ces// bka' stsal bka' nan chen po mdzad//

//bcas pa dang rang bzhin gyi dge ba tha dad du yod pa yin nam snyam na/ yang khams gsum rgyal po 'gro ba'i mgon// thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs pa des// nyon mongs las dang rnam smin gyis// 'khor ba ngan song sdug bsngal bskyed// de bas 'di ni spang bya ste// nyon mongs med cing de yi las// 'bras bu lha mi'i bde skyid dang*// byang chub rnam gsum thob pa'i phyir// rjes 'brang sras la bsgrub byar gsungs// 'di babs dang gshis kyi gnas tshul de// mkhyen cing gzigs pas sras rnams la// bslab pa bcas par mdzad pa las// sems can gzhan la nyes med pa'i// bcas pa'i kha na ma tho ba// ci gsung bka' stsal mi 'da' zhing*// nye zhing brtse ba'i slob ma la// sgos byur du nyes pa bkal ba min// sems can rnams kyis ma shes pas// gti mug ma rig mun par 'thoms/pa dang*// kha zas kyi ro la chags pa spang*// rgyal po chen po nga las nus// gling bzhi sum cu rtsa gsum gyi// brgya byin lha yi dbang po yi// stan phyed kyis ma ngoms gsod sems skyes// skad cig gis sa yi steng du lhung*// de bas sdong dum mes tshig la'ang*// ngan sems bskyed par mi bya zhing*// 'dod la ngoms pa yod med pas// de bas 'dod yon spang bar gsungs// de phyir chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi// lus ngag mi dge bdun yin pas// mkhas pa'i skyes bu 'ga' zhig gis// spong bdun 'khor dang bcas pa zer// 'dod chags 'dod chags dang bral dang*// zhe sdang gti mug de bzhin te// sems dang shes rab rnam grol bar// 'dul ba'i sde snod du rgya cher gsu yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa zhes// mdo rgyud rnams su yang dang yang*// nan tan chen pos gdams pa de// da dung khyed kyis ma thos sam// slob dpon yon tan 'od kyis kyang*// 'du shes gtso zhes mi gsung ngam// 'di na khyed rang res 'ga' zhig

/ltung ba sde lnga'i khyad par 'di// nyon mongs che 'bring gi bye brag da yin yang bde ba yi// rnam smin 'bras bu 'byung ba'i phyir// gcig tu dge ba'i las rnams la// bslab par bya zhes yang dang yang*// thub mgon shākya'i rgyal pos gsungs// bu gcig rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// gshis kyi dge dang mi dge dang*// bcas dang rang bzhin gcig pa 'di// rgyal ba'i gsung nyid yin mod kyang*// tshig gi rjethub pa chen pos gsungs pa'i chos// gdod nas zhi zhing ma skyes pa// mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas lugs 'di// sems can rnams kyi 'dug lugs yin// de ma go rtogs par ma gyur pas// rgyu rkyen glo bur du tshogs pa yin// nga bdag 'dzin pa'i rtog pa skyes// 'di gti mug brtag pa'i log rtog la// 'dod cing chags pas bdag gzhan du// 'dzin pa de las 'dod chags dang*// zhe sdang gti mug skyes gyur te// yul lnga'i rjes su dbang po 'brangs// sred pa'i 'ching bas rgyun du 'khor// don med sdug bsngal mang po myong*// phung byed dgra bo mi bzad pa// mi gtsang lus 'dis gos gos nas// mi rtog dur khrod kyi nang du 'jug /'di 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin yin// bu 'khor ba 'di las skyob pa'i skyabs// bla med byang chub chen po de// rang gi sems kyi de bzhin nyid// shes rab pha rol phyin pa yin// 'di gnas dang grogs dang bla mas kyang*// bskyed par nus pa ma yin te// bdag 'dzin gyi rtog pa skyes pa yis// ngo bo shes pa ma gtogs pa'i// mi rtog sgom rgyu yod pa min// 'di goms par byed pa'i man ngag gis// 'ching byed 'dzin pa las grol phyir// thub pa'i sbyangs pa'i yon tan dang*// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa dang*// nan tan chen pos 'bad par bya// yul gang la 'dzin pa'i rtog pa de// skye med rig par go ba la// chos kyi sgo zhes brjod pa yin// rtog 'dzin btang ba'i sbyin pa la// ngo bo lhun grub tshul khrims so// de la mi bzod med pa dang*// rtsol ba spangs pa'i brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan ting 'dzin de bsgom pa// de nyid shes pa shes rab yin// lus dang ngag dang yid rnams kun// mi rtog lhun grub du gnas pa de// sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs// mkha' ltar rnam dag yin zhes gsungs//

//byang chub malas kyis mi gnod pa// gdug la byams par mi bya ste// bsgral ba'i zhing de bsgral nas kyang*// sems ni sangs rgyas gnas su spar// lus tshogs kyi 'khor lor byas pas kyang*// ji ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// sgrol byed yak+ṣa he ru kas// gdug pa gsol ba'i 'bras bu de// mi bsrun 'khor rnams dngangs shing brgyal// bcom ldan nyes pa kun spangs pa// sgrib pa gsum dang bral na yang*// rgyu las 'bras bu nges 'byung ste// 'khor dang bye brag med gyur pas// mya ngan sdug bsngal myong bar 'gyur// nyon mongs dug gsum rgyal ba'i rigs// chos skur gsal bas he ru kaḥ /de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis// nyes pa spang zhing legs pa bsgrub// rang gzhan kun la phan par bya// //chos kyi 'khor lo gsum gyi brjod bya'i don dang sa mtshams gang yin snyam na/ lar gyi mtshan nyid ldan pa yi// bla ma dam pa dang ma mjal na// zab mo'i mdo rgyud lta mi shes// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yis// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kun// bka' 'khor lo gsum du sdud par byed// rgyu las dang nyon mongs rjes 'brangs pas// 'bras bu sdug bsngal gyi phung por smin// las nyon mongs gsum po med pa yi// 'bras bu 'gog pa'i bden pa thob// dag dang ma dag rgyu 'bras 'di// gtso bor yod ces gsungs pa kun// bden pa bzhi yi 'khor lo yin// sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'gog pa dang*// lam gyi bden pa stong pa nyid// dngos po dngos po nyid kyis stong*// 'khor 'das mnyam nyid pha rol phyin// 'di mtshan ma med pa'i 'khor lo yin// mnyam nyid rtogs pa gzhir bzhag nas// sku dang ye shes yon tan gyi// 'bras bu lhun grub rtag pa'i bdag /gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa// nges pa don gyi 'khor lo yin// 'di dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod du// thub pa'i stobs dang mi 'jigs gzugs// yon tan ma lus thams cad gsung*// de nges don chos kyi 'khor lo yi// brjod bya mthil du bstan pa yin// pha rol phyin pa drug gi lam// bdag med rnam pa gnyis kyi don// 'di theg pa chen po'i brjod bya yin// smra bsam brjod med pha rol phyin// skye dang 'gag pa med pa'i don// 'di mtshan ma med pa'i brjod bya yin// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod nyid// bden pa bzhi yi ngo bor gnas// bu de phyir chos kyi 'khor lo gsum// 'khor lo gcig la tshang ba yin// gsang sngags bla med rgyud rnams kun// rnal 'byor ma yi 'dul ba ste// bden pa bzhi dang sde pa bzhi// bshad pa'i don 'di go bar bya// chos kyi 'khor lo phyi ma yi// sa bon snga ma la gnas pas// nyan thos rnams dang rang sangs rgyas// byang chub sems dpa' chen po dang*// rgyal ba rnams kyi yum gyur pa// shes rab pha rol phyin pa de// tshogs drug tu gsungs pa nyan thos kyi// ngo bsrung mdzad pa yin pa'i phyir// byang chub sems dpa' sbyang gzhi de// nyon mongs can dang kun gzhi yin// de yi rgyu mtshan gang zhe na// 'bras bus rgyu rnams dpag pa'i phyir// so sor yang dag rig pa bzhi// rtog pa gcig la'ang tshang ba yin// shin tu phra ba'i nyon mongs dang*// rnam par rtog pa thams cad la// de yi rgyu 'bras gang yin pa// don dang tshig dang nges tshig dang*// spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa yis// lhar bcas kun gyi 'dren par 'gyur// 'di dgu pa'i dus su rtogs pa yiskyed pa zhig gis sangs rgya bar// 'dod pas pha rol phyin pa las// bslab par bya zhes gsungs pa dang*// lo bcu gnyis dag gi nang rol du// nor bzang gis kun tu bzang po thob// byang chub sems dpa' rtag tu ngus// tshe de la sa bcu'i pha rol phyin// de phyir tshe gcig sangs rgyas par// pha rol phyin par gsungs pa lags// dam chos 'dul ba'i sde snod du// dka' thub dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis// byang chub thob par ma gsungs te// rje btsun byams pas dus gsum du// smon lam btab pas lam bde zhing*// 'jug pa bde bas byang chub thob// mtha' gnyis bral bas ting 'dzin gyi// dga' bde la brten rdzogs sangs rgyas// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// gsang sngags ོga dbang gong ma zab zer yang*// nga 'bu bum dbang la brtsi tshod che// gzhi dang snod dang lus lta bu// de yi khyad par gong ma gsum// cho ga'i rnam bzhag ma gtogs pa// tshad ldan bla ma'i byin rlabs yin// myong ba skyes pa thob par bzhed// gzhan lus la sogs bsten pa dang*// byin rlabs kyi ting 'dzin la khyad par med// 'di cis kyang 'bras bu mi 'grub pas// de yi rigs can gdul bya rnams// smin par byed pa'i mthu med lags// 'di 'og min gnas mchog dam pa der// yang dag rdzogs sangs rgyas pa la// rigs bzhi thub pas dbang bskur ba// de nyid 'dus par rgya cher gsungs//

//pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags kyi dgongs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gcig la gsang sngags shes pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ mtshan nyid gsang sngags thams cad du// skye med shes rab pha rol phyin// sems nyid 'od gsal chos sku de// rtogs bya'i 'bras bu yin par gcig /kun rdzob smon 'jug byang chub sems// de yi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las// pha rol phyin pa bcur rdzogs nas// sa bcu la gnas sangs rgya ba// don 'di mtshungs par 'dra na yang*// shin tu gsal ba'i khyad par yod// 'bras bu chos sku nye ba'i dus// gsang sngags khyad par 'phags pa yin// nyes pa du ma'i gzhir 'gyur te// mar 'grib snyigs ma lnga bdo bas// g.yul log chen po byung ba'i tshe// dpa' bo chen po khyad par 'phags// de yang phyi yi rnam bzhag go// mthong lam ye shes rtogs pa'i thabs// rgyu tha dad la brten nas rtogs pa la// theg pa'i khyad par bsam mi khyab// shes rab pha rol phyin pa las// dus gsum la sogs 'khor 'das chos// rnam par dag pas dag pa zhes// logs su byung dogs gsungs nas yod// thun mong ma yin khyad par chos// 'bru dang shing thog mar dang ni// mar khu chen po zhes bya ba// shin tu gsang ba'i gnad 'di yin// ye shes mthong bar byed pa yi// lam gyi khyad par gang zhe na// phyag rgya mtshan nyid ldan pa dang*// stan cig tu tshogs pas tshogs lam yin// dbyer med sbyor ba sbyor ba'i lam// ye shes mthong ba mthong ba'i lam// mthong lam la tha dad med gyur kyang*// gzhi la brten nas mthong ba'i phyir// rten gsum rnam par sbyong ba de// sgom pa'i lam zhes bla mas gsungs// de yang 'od gsal sems nyid du// nyon mongs dag par byed pa de// skyes nas sbyong bar byed pa la// sa yi rim pa rdzogs nas kyang*// 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen thob// dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyi// brgyud ldan rje btsun mi la yis// don 'di rtogs shing khong du chud// 'ga' zhig shor dang ma shor zhes// smra bar gyur pa rdzun re che// 'di la dbab dang bzlog pa dang*// gzung zhing dgram la mkhas bya zhes// mkhas pas bzhi po bshad pa kun// mi 'dod 'bras bu 'byung bar nges// grol lam la zhugs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dmigs pa dang*// rlung gi man ngag phyag rgya yin// bde chen ting 'dzin skyes gyur pa// dbab pa mi dgos bab pa yin// de la zab pa'i gdams ngag yod// gser 'gyur rtsi yi sbyor ba yis// rtsa dang rlung dang byang chub sems// de yis kha bsgyur gser du 'gyur// gser la sku mchog byas pa ltar// yi dam lha ru nges par blta// don ི bsgom pa ma yin te// don rang gi mtshan nyid mngon du 'gyur// ba spu'i bu ga la sogs pa// gsal bar 'gyur ba the tshom med// rtsa bar gyur pa'i gnad 'di ni// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub dang*// zhing sogs las rnams thams cad kun// rnal 'byor sems kyis kha bsgyur bas// 'byung bar 'gyur ba'i nges shes yod//

//rim pa lnga ltar nyams su len pa'i sgom 'di dang sbyar na ji ltar 'ong snyam na/ ིra thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa// slob dpon 'phags pas thugs su chud// sa bdun la gnas byang chub sems// sangs rgyas bzhi la smon lam btab// thub pa'i dgongs pa 'grel pa las// phyi sgro 'dogs chod pa'i chos rnams kun// dbu ma'i bstan chos chen po yin// nang nyams myong skyes pa'i rim pa lnga// bskyed pa'i rim pa dang po yin// 'di skyon dang yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// byang chub sems las skyes pa'i lha// gsal zhing brtan pas bzlas pa bya// gsal byed yan lag yin pa'i phyir/rtogs shing khong du chud// snang la ma nges 'khrul pa de// sgyu ma ma yin rten 'brel gyi// tshogs pa de la sgyu ma zer// de nyid gdod nas skye med cing*// mnyam nyid spros dang bral bar rtogs// 'di 'od gsal mngon du gyur pa yin// 'od gsal sgyu ma la sogs pa// gang du grub pa med gyur cing*// bsal dang bzhag pa med pa la// rgyu dang 'bras bu ma 'gags pa// zung du 'jug ces de la brjod// 'di rim gyis pa dang cig car ba// mi pham mgon pos sbyin pa la// pha rol phyin drug tshang bar gsungs// slob dpon klu yi byang chub kyis// rim pa gcig la'ang lnga tshang bar// bskyed pa'i khongs su bsdu bar gsungs// des na gnyis po gang la'ang*// 'gal bar gyur pa med pa lags/ //nges par thugs kyi dgongs pa'i phyag rgya chen po de gang yin snyam na/ 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// dam chos phyag rgya chen po de// rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba yin// rten 'brel rgyu rkyen tshogs pa las// srid pa'i dra ba 'byung ba de// skye 'gag spros pa'i mtha' las 'das// skye med phyag rgya chen po de// spros pa 'di las gzhan du med// e ma mthar thug phyag rgya che// spros las gzhan du med par go// ma rig nyid kyis der 'gyur te// 'di ni bcom ldan 'das kyi bka'// bu mo gser mchog 'od gsal la// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyis gdams pa yin// rten 'brel lugs 'byung lugs ldog 'di// rang sangs rgyas kyi yin zhe na// ma rig 'khorab sems kyis dbang byas pa'i// dngos po gang yang rung ba de// sems can khams dang sangs rgyas khams// mnyam pa nyid du gyur nas kyang*// dngos po ji ltar phul ba ltar// 'bras bu de yi rjes su 'brang*// rgyal po chen po nga las nus// sran rdog phyed dang lnga po de// byang chub sems kyis dbang byas pas// 'gro ba smin par byed pa cig

/'on kyang dngos po ji bzhin du// 'bras bu 'byung bar nges pas na// sum cu rtsa gsum du phyin pa dang*// sa yi steng du lhung ba yis// 'gro don byas la khyad par med// ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// rgyu 'bras che ba'i 'khor lo de// rgyun chad med par 'byung ba'i phyir// bcas pa'i ra ba las 'da' na yang*// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// 'da' bar mdzad cing 'da' ba des// 'gro ba smin cing grol bar byed// 'di ltar gnas brtan 'od bsrungs kyis// rje btsun 'jam dbyangs zla ba gsum// rgyal po gsal rgyal gyi khab du bzhugs// de gnas nas 'byin par brtsams pa las// byang chub sems dpa'i cho 'phrul gyis// nyan thos chen po zil gyis mnan// nyan thos theg pa ba rnams kyis// byang chub sems dpa' chen po yi// ltung ba gleng bar mi bya zhes// de bzhin gshegs pas bcas pa mdzad// des na sems can smin grol de// nyon mongs gsum gyis byed mi srid// de la nyes pa med pa'i phyir// nyes med bsgrub pa'i bslab par gsungs// nyes par gyur pa'i gnad 'di gdams// //gzhan pas khyad par 'phags pa'i chos gang yin snyam na/ yang 'di na 'ga' zhig rin chen gnyis// stong nyid dang rgyu 'bras tha dad 'dod// rje yis bka' stsal gsung na yang*// stong nyid kyi 'brug sgra ma gtogs pa// rgyu 'bras smra ba gcig kyang med// rnam par thar pa nub gyur te// dge bshes zhang gis tshogs 'khor bskor// sprang po yin yang yi mug skyes// rin chen zhal nas sgom chen gyi// tsam la bzang ba 'byung ngo zhes// lan gsum bar du lung bstan te// chen po kun phud de byon nas kyang*// yi ge gsum gyi gzungs brjod de// lung bstan the tshom med par byung*// de yi khyad chos gang zhe na// khyod chos la rna bas sems la bzung*// stong nyid mngon par rtogs pa yis// yon tan 'bras bu yin par bzhed// 'di 'khrul pa med par 'byung ba de// rang rig 'dor bar mi 'gyur ba// thub pa rnams kyi dam chos yin// stong nyid mngon rtogs kyis 'khor ba spong*// rgyu 'bras gnyis med sku gnyis med// de phyir byang chub sems nyid de// 'di snang mdzad chen po'i sku gcig kyang*// tha dad gdul bya 'dul ba la// rgyu la brten pa'i sangs rgyas sku// dpag tu med pa 'byung bar 'gyur// sems can gcig la mkha' mnyam gyi// sems can rnams kyi bag chags kyang*// de tsam sems kyis dbang byas pas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin// rgyu dang 'bras bu ma 'dres shing*// mngon par rtogs pas dbyer med pa// nges don gtan la phab pa yin// kha cig mnyam rjes gnyis yin te// mkhyen pa'i skad cig gcig nyid la// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor kun khyab can// bden pa gnyis su 'dod gyur kyang*// phyag rgya chen po rtogs pa la// kun rdzob bden pa ga la srid// rtag tu mnyam par bzhag gyur cing*// mkhyen pa'i ye shes kun la 'jug

/gnyis med mthar phyin ngo mtshar che// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// lar gyi rgyu 'bras bzhed tshul cig /yod de zla ba dka' bar byung*// de ring khyed la bstan byas na// yid la bzung la brnag par gyis// nang du ting 'dzin gang skyes pa// rang gis lus 'di byin gyis brlob// lus kyis snang ba byin gyis brlob// skad cig 'di la mi srid pas// //chos lngar ma 'dus pa'i gdams pa'i man ma dam pa yis// sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi man ngag gis// skyon dang nyes pa 'dag pa dang*// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa// yon tan skye ba'i man ngag yod// 'di shes pa khams su ma song ste// go ba yod pa dbus na med// bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams dang*// stong phrag brgyad cu'i bgegs kyi tshogs// skyon dang nyes pa thams cad la// rang gi lhag pa'i lha nyid kyis// zhal dang phyag dang zhabs la sogs// sku yi rnam 'gyur gcig pu yis// gnad kyis grol bar 'gyur ba 'di// snying rje chen po'i gzungs las kyang*// gnod pa'i gnyen por gyur pa'i phyag /phyag mtshan bcas pa la bltas te// mchod pa bya zhes thub pas gsungs// //mkha' 'gro dpag tu med pa 'byon pa'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ nyon mongs pa rnam par rtog pa kun// spong sems brtan pos dbang byas na// yon tan mtha' med skye 'gyur ba// rgyu dang 'bras bu so sor dpag /'di khyod kyis gzhan la gsang ba yin// mkha' 'gro sde bzhi'i srog snying rje// dpal chen he ru ka la mnga'// de gzhan la ma bstan bcangs gyur pas// ri rab sum cu rtsa drug gi// rdul dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor mas// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog rim gro byed// chos rje 'gro ba'i mgon po la// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams mngon du 'byung*// sgra che ba de slob dpon khams pa yin// dog la 'cham pa 'di lcong mo'i shar mo yin// grangs dang mnyam pa'i mkha' 'gro mas// dus la yol ba med pa de// g.yon pa dag pa'i rten 'brel yin//

//gsang sngags 'bras bu lam du byed pa'i go ba gang yin snyam na/ ma smin smin byed dbang bskur bas// theg chen sngags kyi brjod bya de// gdod nas grub pa'i dkyil 'khor yin// 'bras bu de nyid kyi rgyu lam du// grol bar byed pas mthar phyin 'gyur// des na gong ma'i gnad gsum po// bzhi pa'i ngo bor gdod nas gnas// rkyen las skyes pa'i bsam pa de// skad cig gis 'gag par gyur pas na// sems snang ba gsum po 'od gsal du// 'jug pas sems bskyed gcig pu yang*// 'od gsal yin phyir slob dpon gyis// sa brgyad thob par bzhed pa yin// sems dang lta ba'i rig pa 'di nyid de// spros pa'i mtha' dang bral bar rtogs// ting 'dzin mngon par shes pa dang*// rdzogs sangs rgya ba sems nyid rten// 'khor 'das kun gyi sa bon yin// sa bon kun gzhi rnam shes de// rigs dang snang bar byed pa 'di// yul dang dus kyi bye brag yin// //rje btsun lha lnga mas chos sgo phyed dam snyam na/ phyag mang po yod pa'i dgos byed de ci yin/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo ma gtogs pa// lha pho reng mo reng gang gis kyang*// dbang bskur thob par mi 'dod zhes// slob dpon chen po sa skyas gsung*// 'on kyang sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// phung po khams dang skye mched kun// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo rgya chen gsungs// mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni rnam par grags// rdo rje skye mched thams cad ni// byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor nyid// dpung pa g.yas pa gshin rje gshed// mtha' yas bsam gyis mi khyab pa// rang nyid gcig pur gsungs pa yin// bum pa'i dbang gi go ba de// rang nyid gdod nas byang chub tu// rdzogs sangs rgyas par shes shing rtogs// 'di bla ma'i drin gyis thoba'i gzugs su bstan// de la dpal ldan nā ro pa'i// phyag rgya chen po thugs nyid kyis// yi ge bzhi pa ces bya ba// srog thig ler gzhug pa'i man ngag bya// dmu chu 'khrul 'khor de nyid kyi// dbye ba med par chud par 'gyur//

//nges par 'chi ba'i ltas gang yin ji ltar bzlog snyam na/ bla med gsang sngags rgyud rnams su// legs par gsungs pa'i don gyi gnad// gdams pa'i mchog gyur rtsa dang rlung*// byang chub sems las med par go// phung po rgyu rkyen las bskyed pa// skyed byed rgyu gnyis a dang haṃ// ji srid gnas tshe mi 'pho zhing*// gal te 'pho bar gyur pa na// spre'u dkar sna dmar bzhon byas nas// shar gyi phyogs su 'gro ba 'byung*// 'di ni bzlog par mi nus te// byang sems sprin gseb sba bas bsring*// tha mar bug pa gnyis nas 'byung*// a haṃ gnyis kyi mthu stobs kyis// lus gnas phyir na mthun pa'i rkyen// me dang chu yi khams brten pas// 'phel bas yon tan du ma 'byung*// de yi rigs mthun rdzas rnams kun// bcud kyis len zhes yongs su grags// bcud len rdzas rnams 'byung ba yi// gnad kyi nges pa dpag med pa// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i rgyud du gsungs// rtsa gsum chags dang sdang ba dang*// dbu ma mi rtog ting 'dzin yin// g.yas g.yon gnyis nas rtag rgyu na// chags dang sdang ba'i stobs 'phel nas// myur du 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i phyir// rlung dbu mar tshud pa'i gdams ngag bya// nang gi ting 'dzin skyon med gsum// phyi ni bdud rtsi bcud kyi len// gnas ni gsal ba zhes bya grags// de phyir thub pa chen po'i chos// gcig shes kun la mkhas pa de// spang bya gnyen por 'gyur ba'i phyir// mtha' med bsam gyis mi khyab pas// rten 'brel mtha' dag go bar bya// yang theg chen gsang sngags ma lus par// mi bzad 'jigs pa'i sku 'byung ba// gdul bya nyon mongs can rnams la// phrin las dus gsum 'dres pa'i sku// rang 'od kyi rig ma pad gdan dang*// byang chub sems gnyis kyi khyad par la// rang nyid ci 'dra de 'dra dang*// rang bzhin gnas dang rkyen sad pas// rang nyid de dang 'dra bar 'gyur// gsad pa rigs sngags phyag rgya che// sgyu ma'i rtog pa zos pa la// skye dang 'byin pa kho na nyid// de la sdig tu mi 'gyur te// gsol ba lan gsum gdab pa'i chos//

//gtum mo'i gnad kyis yon tan bskyed pa de gang gis bskyed snyam na/ dpal ldan nā ro paṇa chen gyis// gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa// gtum mo bla med dgongs pa'am// mi la chen pos nyams su myong*// phyi dang nang dang gsang ba dang*// dal ldan rdo rje 'chang chen de// yab dang yum las byung ba gnyis// brtan pa'i rtags su nyi ma dang*// zla ba nor bus brgyan pa byung*// nyin mo rtsa ba'i gnad khegs pa// mtshan mo 'gyur byed 'ching bar 'gyur// tha mal rnams kyis mi tshor te// mtshan du lhung bar 'gyur ba yin// de lta'i dus su drod che bas// zas kyi dngos po 'ju bar byed// khams la phan dang stobs 'phel phyir// thub pas zas tshod rig bya ste// bka' stsal nan tan chen por gsungs// slob dpon 'phags pas nyes pa rnams// ma zhu ba yi bskyed byed zhes// gsungs pa de dag thams cad kun// rtsa ba'i gnad 'dis bskyed pa yin// thog ma bar dang mthar dge bas// yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pas// ye shes me dpung chen po yin// //rgyud rnams su rtsis kyi rnam pa dpag tu med pa gsungs pa de'i gnad gang yin snyam na/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags su// gza' dang rgyu skar tshes grangs dang*// khams dang dus kyi gnad rnams gsungs// 'di phyi nang gsang gsum gyi rten 'brel yin// phyi 'byung ba bzhi yi 'du 'phrod kyis// phan dang gnod pa 'byung ba yi// rig byed gtsug lag thams cad kun// shes pa mu stegs byed dang mtshungs// de dag nang gi bsam pa'i gnad// 'brel pa gcig tu gyur pa 'di// thub pa chen po'i bka' yin pas// sangs rgyas byon pa'i khyad par chos// med na mi 'byung gi 'bras bu yin// de ji bzhin rdo rje'i lus kyi gnad// phyi rol de bzhin yis// dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i gnad rnams go// rang min pa gzhan med kyi bsam pa skye// dpal stag lung thang pa la dri ba dris// khong bshad dam gsungs pa mi bshad par// zhu ba phul ba'i bka' stsal gsung*// 'di la 'byung ba bzhi po yi// gnad 'di min pa med pa yin// lus phung po lnga po 'byung bas bskyed// de bzhi po 'gyur bas nyes pa bskyed// 'di sems can dus dang lam gyi dus// 'bras bu rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i tshe// rigs lnga yum gyi byed pa yin// byang phyogs sa yi dkyil 'khor la// grub pa rlung gi bdag nyid bzhugs// lho phyogs rlung gi dkyil 'khor la// rin chen 'byung ldan sa yi khams// chu ni me yi gnyen po ste// so sor skyon du 'gyur ba'i phyir// de yi gnyen por bzhugs pa yin// bu rten 'brel ma lus 'di go mdzod//

//bsgrub pa byas pas dngos grub 'byung ba'i tshul ji lta bu snyam na/ rang nyid yi dam lha bsgom zhing*// bza' btung bdud rtsir byin rlabs la// tshogs kyi 'khor lo gsol bar zhu// dam pa'i chos 'di shin tu gnyan// gsang sngags bla med bsgrub pa la// dngos grub mi mthun phyogs kun dang*// bar du gcod pa sna tshogs 'byung*// rgya mtsho'i 'gram du klu grub ste// nam mkha' lta bu'i rba rlabs kyis// mi g.yo ci 'dod dam pa sbyin// ro langs bsgrubs pas ha he zhes// sgrog cing langs par gyur pa'i tshe// dam rdzas sbyin cing ci 'dod bslangs// gnod sbyin sbyor ba sna tshogs kyi// mi mthun phyogs rnams bsgrub pa la// glang chen rab brtan rnal 'byor pas// zla drug goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dpon g.yog rim par zhabs tog byed// g.yog ni yid 'ong lha yi bu// dpon ni khro gtum rngam pa'i zhal// sa bdag rdo rje 'dzin pa'am// khro mchog ya man ta ka sogs// gnyen por gyur pa bsgoms gyur na// ma dang bran mo 'grub par sla// chung ma mi zad cho 'phrul ston// lcang lo can nam sum cu'i gnas// bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas su 'dren// 'dir yang rtsa ba'i man ngag las// cung zad tsam yang 'dar mi rung*// 'di gsang sngags gcig pu ma yin te// rang nyid gsod pa'i gshed ma la// byams dang bzod thob chen po yis// phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la*// de yi yon tan mngon rtogs 'byung*// 'du shes tung tung med gyur na// gong nas gong du 'phel ba dang*// byin rlabs 'jug pa mi nus la// bsgom bya sgom du rtogs pa des// gzhan don khyad du bsgrub dgos te// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// 'gro ba'i don rnams bsgrub pa de// sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' yin// //ro gcig rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la rtogs pa skye ba dang skye ba med pa gnyis su gsungs pa'i don ci yin snyam na/

gnyis med ro gcig rtogs pa yi// nyon mongs rnam rtog med pa de// go ba 'dzin pa med pa yin// ka ba mthong dang mi 'dzin pas// de med de yi snang ba med// des ni theg pa chen po mthong*// ka bar 'dzin pas drang zhes dang*// yo zhes rtog pa ma rig pa// //ro gcig rtogs pa la yon tan ci yang med par gsal ba snang na de'i yon tan gang yin snyam na/ ro gcig rtogs par gyur pa la// de yi yon tan gang zhig yin// ro gcig de la tha mal nyams// rtse gcig spros bral mi snang bas// phrag dog skyes dang gzhan gyi 'khor// gang yin de la bsal bzhag med// las dang nyon mongs de bzhin te// de las gzhan pa'i yon tan med// sems nyid 'od gsal rtogs pa de// bdud rtsi rnyed pa lta bu yin// bdud rtsi thu ba lta bu de// rgyun chad med par bsgom pa yin// de rgyun bsrings nas ma bsgom na// yon tan 'byung ba ga la srid// chos rjes bdag la gdams pa yin grags pa'i dam chos kyis// 'khor 'das dbang sdud bde ba che// byang chub shing drung bdud kyi sde// bcom pa ting 'dzin gsum lags pas// tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug dang*// rang byung lhan cig skyes pa nyid// mthar thug ting 'dzin la gnas pas// 'jig rten kun gyi skyabs kyi gnas// £ ga ling ga'i mchod pa yis// bu mang nor ldan dngos grub thob// //yon bdag mo gnyis kyis khab skud bskur ba la mnyes pas khyed la yang de 'dra ba 'byung bar 'dod na/ rang gis ji ltar byas pa yi// 'bras bu ma gtogs gzhan na med// sngon 'jig rten mgon po bla ma la// sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes skyes// 'gro ba kun la phan bde yi// bsam pa drag po'i bskul mas bskul// mang shos zi bol srang bcu bzhi// srang bdun bdag gis phul ba la// dngos grub len ces bka' gsal gsung*// bu khyod kyis nga la ci byas pa'i// 'bras bu 'byung bar 'gyur ba la// bsgrub pa'i byed po gzhan na med//

//bla ma rnams kyis slob ma skyong ba'i tshul lugs gang yin snyam na/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang*// gnyis su med par 'dres pa yis// dge sbyor skyong bar shes pa rnams// bla mas bsgom la mi bskul te// dben par gnyid pas gdong pa skrangs// mdze por gyur pa dgos pa med// kha che dgon pas zangs dkar la// gtsug lag khang rnams gsos shig dang*// bar dor phyag rgya chen po yi// dngos grub tu byin gyis brlab bo zhes// gnang ba med dang ri khrod pas// mai tri chen pos bshad pa la// bskul bar gyur pa ji bzhin du// 'dir yang bya byed thams cad la// mkhas pas bya ba bsgrub par bya// rdzas dang yo byad mthun pa'i rkyen// sa phyogs gang du yang med mi srid// rang bsgrub bya'i zhe 'dod dmigs byas la// lan gsum gyi bar du tshang gnyis la khyad par med// rigs gang byed de yi gnyen po gcig /bsten pas snyam nas yon tan bskyed// 'di kha yo snam bu srong ba yin// //gegs 'byung ba'i rgyu dang sel ba'i thabs gang yin snyam na/ sgrub pa rtse gcig tu byed pa la// bar chad bdud dang nye ba'i tshogs// bla ma la ji ltar bltas pa bzhin// de yi dngos grub 'byung bar 'gyur// nyes skyon bzlog par byed pa'i thabs// rgyu gang las skyes pa'i 'bras bu de// sangs rgyas mthus kyang mi bzlog pas// skyon dang po de dag spangs pa yi// bla ma sangs rgyas su bsgoms byas nas// de nges shes skyes pa'i dus su bzlog /de gegs sel mthar thug gi man ngag yin// //myong ba skyes pa'i bogs 'don pa'i mnun rdzogs pa// phun tshogs lnga yi rten 'brel yin// dus der mig gis phye btsum dang*// kha zas brtson 'grus 'bad brtsol dang*// bsgom dang gnas kyi rim pa kun// nges par bzung zhing legs par bsgrub// mthun pa'i rkyen rnams thams cad kyis// yon tan mu mtha' med par nges//

//bsgom pa'i gnas la khyad yod dam snyam na/ ri khrod dben pa'i dgos pa dang*// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung gnyis// bsgrub pa byed par gyur pa na// gnyan dang mi gnyan khyad par med// 'jigs su rung ba'i gnas rnams su// rtsol ba brtson 'grus che na yang*// bla ma'i zhabs drung byin rlabs che// rtsol ba de nyid zhi ba yi// byin rlabs chen po 'byung ba yin// //'khor ba la mtha' yod med dang sems can la zad pa yod med kyi don ji lta bu yin snyam na/ lar sems can zhes bya rnam rtog ste// rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag /thog ma med cing tha ma med// de nyid rtogs par ma gyur pas// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khor gyur te// gti mug bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin// khyad par chos la zad pa med// 'di yod dang med pa ma yin te// gdod nas gnyis su med par gnas// de phyir gsar dang rnying ma yin// sems nyid 'od gsal rtogs pa'i tshe// ma rig sprin tshogs rang sar dag /'khor ba'i chu bo skem par 'gyur// de phyir rtogs dang ma rtogs las// 'bras bu thob dang bsal bzhag med// rang sems dri med chos kyi sku// rang bzhin rnam dag gi snying po de// rig dang ma rig gi khyad par gyis// sangs rgyas dang sems can zhes byar grags// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor la// tha dad gus pa med pa'i phyir// ma rig med cing zad pa med// rnam shes nyid kyang byang chub la// byang chub rnam par shes pa nyid// 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos rnams kun// ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag /tha dad bag chags kyi sa bon de// thog med dus nas gnas pa yin// rgyu rkyen tshogs pas sad pa gang*// rnam shes de yi gzugs su 'gyur// nyon mongs gsum gyi khyad par dang*// nyon mongs med pas dbang byas pas// skye gnas sna tshogs su skye ba 'di// shin tu zab cing phra ba'i chos// e ma ngo mtshar rmad du byung*//

//thub pa'i bstan pa snying rjes rab tu phye bar gsungs na/ mu stegs byed la yang snying rje yod pas khyad ci yis 'byed snyam na/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa de// snying rje chen po dngos yin pas// 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po yin// de bas mu stegs 'tshang rgyar 'gyur// 'on kyang snying rje'i byed las dang*// de yi 'bras bu gang yin la// shes shing rtogs pa med pa yi// lam log la zhugs pa mu stegs pa// de nyid shes pa sangs rgyas yin// des na bdag tu 'dzin pa de// rgyang 'phen yin zhes gsungs pa'i phyir// snod gcig gi nang du sman dang dug /'dres nas blug pa sman pas phyed// de bzhin thub pa chen po yis// dgag dang bsgrub pa'i bcas pa mdzad// //zhing gdam pa dang mi gdam pa gnyis gsungs nas 'dug pa de'i dgongs pa gang yin snyam na/ tshad med rnam pa bzhi po 'di// byang sems ma skyes bskyed pa'i rgyu// skyes nas bslab pa lam du bshad// mthar thug sangs rgyas 'phrin las yin// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// yul dman pa gsum po gces bya zhes// bla ma gong mas gsung na yang*// gnod pa bskyal ba gces gyur na// rang nyid la gnod pa rgyun mi 'chad// dam pa ma yin gces gyur na// sangs rgyas bstan la gnod par 'gyur// sems can gces par bzung gyur na// nyon mongs dug gsum gyi dbang thang rgyas// bu thub pas sbyin pa gtong ba la// dug mda' rtog pa ji bzhin du// zhing brtag na pha rol phyin mi rdzin par thugs la zhog/ //bsod nams kyi tshogs rgyun chad med par byed pa'i thabs yod dam snyam na/ bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub de// tshogs gnyis chu bo'i rgyun bzhin du// rgyun chad med par bsags pas 'grub// 'di la zhing dang bsam pa dang*// dngos po rnam pa gsum yin yang*// bsam pa byang chub sems nyid kyis// dus ring thung byin gyis rlabs pa'i phyir// byang chub sems la rgyun chad med// rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo ba yi// rjes kyi man ngag zab mo yis// bla med byang chub kyi rgyur 'gyur phyir// rgyun chad med pa chu bo bzhin// sbyor ba 'gro dang 'ong ba dang*// nyal dang 'dug dang nyan pa dang*// smra dang bsgom pa thams cad kyang*// bsam pa bzang po'i khyad par gyis// dam chos thos par ma gyur kyang*// bar chad bsrung phyir sgo bsrung ba// khro bo chen por bsgyur ba ltar// sbyor ba rgyun chad med par bsgrub// dngos po phra ba gcig phul yang*// byang chub tu bsngos pas 'di dang gzhan// mthar thug sangs rgyas bsgrub pa'i phyir// 'bras bu gsum po de la tshang*// skye ba phyi ma gcig pur bsngos// skyes nas myong dang gzhan la myong*// 'bras bu gzhan la smon lam gyis// khyad par gyis 'grub par 'gyur ba yin// rten 'brel gsum po tshang ba yis// yon tan thams cad skye bar byed//

//sangs rgyas kyi zhabs la seng ldeng gi tshal pa zug pa de las kyi sgrib pa yin nam snyam na/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' de// las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa spangs// shes bya'i sgrib pa yod gyur pas// rgyu de la brten pa'i 'bras bu 'byung*// de nyon mongs rgyu 'bras yin par nges// byang chub sems kyi dbang byas pas// 'gro ba byang chub thob pa'i thabs// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsgrub bya yin// de spros bral gdod nas dag pa la// byas pa dang byung ba gang yang med// sems kyang gdod nas med gyur na// las dang nyon mongs smos ci dgos// dang po khas len gsum po la// ji ltar byas kyang btub pa yin// don go ba gsum pos go bar bya// mdo gsum gyi dgongs pa dus 'dir go/ //byang chub sems dpa' skye ba sna tshogs 'dzin pa la// smon lam ma gtogs pa'i rgyu dgos sam snyam na/ dgos te/ yang byang chub sems dpa' bsam mi khyab// skye ba'i sa bon lhun gyis grub// byang chub sems dang rtogs pa dang*// bsod nams tshogs kyis 'grub 'gyur kyang*// smon lam gyi ma yin klur skye ba// 'grub byed rgyu yang gang yin dgos// klu yi rgyal po e la'i 'dab// rgyu 'bras la rmongs shing zhe sdang bas// shing gi yal ga bcad pa yis// klu yi skye gnas su skyes pa yin// //skye byed kyi sa bon yig 'brur gsungs pa de'i don gang yin snyam na/ skyes pa'i sa bon yi ge'i sgo// don ston mig gis gzugs ston pa// de ring min pa gsang ba yin// mig gis yi ge la brten nas// rab 'bring tha ma gsum mthong ste// chags dang sdang dang rmug pa skye// chags sdang skyes pa'i mig gi gzugs// sa bon gang yin dbang byas pas// de yi mthun rkyen sgrub pa yin// ji ltar me long gzugs brnyan bzhin// 'byung bar dka' sla'i bye brag gis// bag chags sa bon gang yin pa// gsod par byed pa'i rkyen rnams kun// tshogs ma tshogs gnyis kyi bye brag gis// 'byung dka' sla'i bye brag de yin zhing*// byams pa skyes pa'i snang ba la// pha bsad pa'i mi la phan pa bsgrub// zhe sdang skyes pa'i snang ba la// slob dpon a ba glang mgor mthong*// rtog pa re re skyes pa la// mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa lnga// shin tu rgyas pa'i bka' gsal gsung*//

//dag pa'i sa gsum gyi mnyam rjes kyi khyad par ci yin snyam na/ yongs su dag pa'i sa gsum la// lus dang ngag dang yid gsum po// don thams cad sems las med gyur pas// gcig la gsum ga tshang na yang*// gtso bor gang gyur gyi khyad par yin// sems chos nyid spros bral rtogs gyur kyang*// rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu yi// snang ba rtogs par ma gyur pas// mnyam rjes kyi 'dzin pa nyid dang ldan// dngos po ting 'dzin mnyam bzhag la// dngos por 'dzin pa rjes yin zhes// rtog ge ba dag smra na yang*// snang dang mi snang spros pa'i tshogs// mnyam bzhag chen por gyur pa la// de las gzhan pa'i rjes de gang*// 'di mnyam nyid rtogs pa yan chad nas// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi khyad chos yin// //de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku la a ba glang mgor mthong ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams// bsam gyis mi khyab skur snang ba// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku de nyid// 'ga' zhig gnod pa byed par snang*// de kho rang gi bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin// skos phor la ri mo yod gyur na// sa tsha la ri mo 'byung ba ltar// rgyu yi 'brel pa de nyid kyis// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mchog la 'god// da ltar nga yi tshig ngan dang*// rgya gad rnam pa sna tshogs pas// nyes pa bzlog cing yon dang*// de nyid de las gzhan pa med// ngas ni stong gsum 'jig rten pas// mtha' med 'khor 'das 'dus par go// byang chub sems kyi sku de nyid// gangs chen rnam par snang mdzad yin// da nang snyung dri byas pa des// de ring nyi ma blo bde bas// phye gtor ma gtogs gzhan med pas// rang nyid kyis rang la phye gtor dgos// nga 'grangs pas bza' ba mi za'o// snyam nas dang ga khad kyis 'gags// 'di dang gzhan yang bza'o zhes// snyam na bza' btung mang po thub// 'di yi rtsa ba'i man ngag cig /yod de khyed kyis 'dzin mi 'dzin// 'dzin na mna' skyol dam bca' gyis// gang la'ang mngon par zhen pa spangs// ma byin rnam par rtog pa med// da ltar de nyid kyi ngang du thim// slad ma ma grub mtha' gnyis bral// dbu ma'i don gyi gnas lugs la// bde dang skyid pa'i yon tan 'byung*// phan byed rgyun de 'di nyid de// dmigs pa'i gnad rnams don 'di yin// 'di khyed kyi gtan du mi bya ste// zhi byed rtogs pa gong 'pho ba// gnad 'dis yon tan sgrub byed kyang*// sus kyang go zhing rtogs pa med// dam pa rgya gar khong rang gis// don de khong du chud de mchi// thub pa'i chos rnams ma lus pa// bdag med rnam gnyis rtogs pa'i gnad// bstan par bya zhing thugs la bzhugs// rkyen dang bral ba gzhi de nyid// yod dang med pa gnyis yin pa// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kyis rtogs// de nyid bsgom par byed pa la// yod dang med pa gang yang min// lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang*// rdo rje lta bu la sogs pa// bye brag dus 'dir rab spangs te// rkyen rnams de nyid yin pa'i phyir// rtogs pas mnyam pa nyid zhes bya// lhan skyes de las skyes pa yis// rtog pa'i bye brag mtha' yas pas// 'bras bu tha dad rnams su 'gyur//

//sangs rgyas kyi sku bzhengs pa la tshad dang mi ldan pa la nyes pa 'byung gsung ba de sangs rgyas la 'byung ba mi srid snyam na/ skyon dang nyes pa du ma rnams// thub pa'i sku la 'byung ba min// tshogs gnyis las byung mtshan ldan pa// de med de yi nyes skyon 'byung*// snang ba rang sems yin pa'i phyir// rtags dang mtshan ma sna tshogs pa// bzang ngan gyi bye brag thams cad kyang*// ston pa'i mtshan dang dpe byad las// bde legs yon tan du ma 'byung*// de las bzlog pa'i mtshan ngan pas// skyon dang nyes pa rgya mtsho bskyed// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// brtag pa rnam pa brgyad du gsungs// nyes pa'i mtshan ma de dag kun// bzlog pa'i gnad cig yod pa 'di// khyed bzhi po 'bul ba gyis dang bstan// zhing rnam dag bla ma dkon mchog la// dngos po rgya chen tshogs bsags pas// tshogs des tshogs min bzlog pa'i phyir// dngos po ngan pa ma lus 'jig /'byung ba ldog par 'gyur ba yin// bsam pa ngan pas bzang po yi// dngos po 'jig par 'gyur ba 'di// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad du// thang bkram du yod kyang rnal 'byor pas// myong ba skyes pas srog tu 'gyur// //nan tan chen po byas nas bsgoms pas bde ba chen po skyes nas mi nyams par byed pa'i thabs ji ltar bsgom snyam na/ dran pa rtse gcig tu bsgoms pa yis// bde stong ting 'dzin bzang po skye// yul la dmigs par mi bya bar// yi dam lha la nges shes bskyed// dpung de nyid kyis bskyed byas nas// thur du ltung ba'i 'jigs pa med// snang med mtshan mo nyam nga bral// //'dre yod pa'i gnas su ji ltar bya snyam na/ shin tu 'jigs shing nyam nga ba// 'dre srin mang po gnas pa der// rang dbang med par sdod dgos shing*// rgyal po chen po la sogs pas// cho 'phrul kun gyis gtses byed na// phyi rol gdon bgegs thams cad kun// gnod pa bsgrub byed logs su med// 'di yi gnod pas mi tshugs pa// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen gyis// bsrung ba'i 'khor lo dpag med gsungs// bdag gis nyams su myong ba ni// skyabs bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// nges par skyabs su song gyur na// de dag skyabs gnas mthar thug yin// byang chub sems dang ldan gyur na// sangs rgyas byang chub sems par 'gyur// rtsa ba'i dam tshig ma nyams na// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro sprin ltar 'du// stong nyid bde chen du ro gcig na// snang srid bla ma dam par 'char// 'di dag kun gyi rtsa ba'i gnad// bu gcig gces pa'i thugs la zhog

/snang ba rang sems yin pa'i phyir// 'khor 'das chos rnams thams cad kun// 'di las med par kho thag chod// //rmi lam ngan pa ji ltar bzlog snyam na/ phan gnod chen po rmi lam du// mthong bar gyur pa bzlog pa la// rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'ga' zhig gis// de nyid du bsgyur bar byed pa dang*// gnyis pa sad cing ma 'gyur ba// nyes pa de las bzlog pa dang*// gsum po de yi rjes su 'brang*// 'di go na nyes skyon thams cad kun// sbyor dngos rjes gyur kyang*// de la su yang yid mi rton// dge sbyor lhun grub tu gnas pa de// nyes pa gsal zhing bzang bar mchi// //bzang po zhig 'dod pas bya ba sgrubs kyang bzang po mi 'byung bar nyes pa 'byung ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ 'di shin tu zab pa'i dam chos yin// rang gi nyams su myong ba las// bsam pa bzang po zhig skyes nas// de yi rjes su 'brangs pa'i las// byas pa dang byed pa rgya chen po// phan bde 'dod pa'i phyir 'bad kyang*// bsgrub bya'i don rnams mi 'grub par// nyes phung rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i// rgyu dang rkyen la zad pa med// mi 'dod sdug bsngal khur gyis non// gnyen 'dun gyi zhen pa la mi thar bas// dpal ldan chen po 'tshal pa yis// rgya chen ra srid pa gsum la dbang bsgyur bas// 'dre srin mang pos gnod pa bsgrubs// 'di 'brel ba'i rgyu mtshan yin nam snyam// //rmi lam mam dngos su lha 'dres lung bstan pa byung na bden nam snyam na/ ིra lung bstan 'byung ba thams cad kun// bden nam mi bden cha med de// sngon yi gas drag pos bdag byas pa'i// khang pa stong par bsdad pa la// srod nas tho rangs bar du non// khyod rang non cig ces byas pas// yang na gtan nas chos ma byed// chos kyi bya long mi 'byung ste// lo gsum na ni khyod 'chi zer// nga ma shi bar du chos byed ces// smras pas de nas kho song ste// da rung bar du ma shi lags// 'on kyang khong gi de rdzun min// khong rang gi mi min snang ba la// de 'chi bar 'gyur ba'i snang ba 'byung*// de yang bsam pa 'gyur bas so// des na chos byed thams cad la// bar chad 'byung ba gang yin pa// khong la 'chi dang med 'gyur ba'i// snang ba 'byung bar nges pa yin// bdud rigs lha rnams thams cad kyis// khong gi gnas las 'das par mthong*// gzhan yang 'da' bar byed dgos nas// paV'i phreng ba'i mgo bo la// dug lnga mtshon pa'i mda' lnga brgyab// ngan pa bsgrub par med min te// 'di ni bar du gcod par 'gyur// 'di la zab pa'i gdams ngag ni// gnod par byed la zhe sdang yang*// byang chub sems kyi rjes 'brangs nas// £ ling la sogs kho yi don// ched du bsams la bsngo bar bya// gzhi ning gdan sa'i zhabs tog byas// bdag nyid chen po mi bzhugs pas// dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab// lung bstan sgra cig mkha' la grags// lo nyi shu rtsa lnga thub po zhes// de bden nam mi bden bdag gis thos//

//gza' skar ngan pa'i bcos ji ltar bya snyam na/ tshes grangs gza' dang rgyu skar gyi// rtsis de bdag gis ma 'tshal te// bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba'i thabs// don 'di khyod kyi thugs la zhog /bskyed rim brtan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// snang dang srid pa lhag pa'i lhar// shar bar gyur na rab gnas dang*// gsang sngags phrin las bsgrub tu rung*// de las sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa'i// snang bar gyur pa gzhan pa med// snang ba chos nyid phyag rgya cher// rtogs par gyur pa gang yin la// phyag rgya chen por ma gtogs pa'i// gza' dang rgyu skar de la med// de nyid rang byung phyag rgya che// dus bzang dang ngan pa'i spros pa bral// 'di yis rab gnas la sogs pa// phrin las bsgrub pa dus med de// rtsis kyi rnam pa thams cad kun// so so skye bo tha mal gyi// chos su gtogs shing go bar bya// //nad kyi bcos ji ltar bya snyam na/ zhing rnam dag bla ma dkon mchog la// bsam pa rnam dag byang sems kyis// dngos po gang phul gyi 'bras bu smin// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// rten 'brel mthu yis bzlog par 'gyur// sbyor ba'i dam chos rnam gsum gyis// rang lus gnad du bsnun nas kyang*// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// bla ma rdo rje 'chang bsgom la// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam 'gyur la// dran pa ma yengs rtse gcig pas// 'dus byas dang 'dus ma byas kyi gnad// rang lus rgya mtsho chen po la// bde chen gru yi sbyor ba yis// gang 'dod nor bu rin chen len// 'grub byed rtsi bcud cung zad kyis// rim gyis gso ba'i thabs su bstan// lte ba'i 'og tu nyi ma rgyu// steng du rgyun chad med par bzlog /shin tu gsang bar ma bsgom na// tshe thung bar 'gyur ba'i skyon du mchi// //nad bying che ba 'thibs pa dang zug che ba gnyis la bsgom pa'i khyad yod dam snyam na/ 'du ba rnam bzhis bsdus pa yi// zug dang sdug bsngal sna tshogs la// spros med phyag rgya chen po yis// gnyis med mkha' ltar dag gyur pas// dngos gzhi gang yin hril gyis 'byung*// de dgos 'dod dbang gi rgyal po ru// nges pa'i shes pa bskyed byas nas// de nyid dngos med mkha' la bstim// de bstim bya stim byed med pa ru// rang byung chen po'i ngang du gnas// ma skyes pha rol phyin pa las// 'khor 'das yon tan thams cad 'byung*// bsgom bya dmigs pa'i yul nyid la// sgom byed kyi shes pa ma yengs dang*// 'bad rtsol gyi mtha' la zhen pa yi// lhun grub kyi sa la gnas pa dka'// 'di chos kyi ye shes kyi go ba yin// gti mug mun pas 'thoms gyur cing*// mi shes mun pas non pa la// de nyid de rgyun bsring byas Vོ chus brlan ltar// gsal zhing rgyas pa'i yon tan 'byung*// kha tsam 'od gsal du song gyur pas// khyed 'gro dang 'ong ba thams cad mthong*// nyams len gyi gnad 'di shes gyur na// yon tan 'byung ba dka' ba min// 'dis ni dam chos ma lus pa'i// dbu rnams dus gcig song ba yin//

//nad thams cad la phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig gis chog gam snyam na/ dngos kun nam mkha'i rang bzhin te// chos rnams stong nyid ro gcig kyang*// bye brag dmigs byed ma grub na// nyes pa'i skyon las mi grol bas// glen pa dmu 'thoms byed pa rnams// gnas lugs go yul gyi bslu bar zad// stong nyid dmigs las gzhan ma yin// dmigs nyid gdod nas dmigs kyis stong*// stong pa nyid kyi chos rnams la// 'khor 'das sna tshogs tha dad 'byung*// gzhi gang la brten nas 'byung gnas su// skyes bu rjes su dran pa gzhug /mi bskyod g.yo ba med pa yi// ngang la gnas pas yul de zin// mi mthun dgra bo'i g.yul bzlog nas// lhun grub sa la gnas pa de// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am// //gza' dang bdud la sogasir yi dam lha yi ting 'dzin gyi// phyed dang phyed min gsal bar snang*// de nyid gsal bar nan tan bskyed// 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// chu mda' gnas der 'du ba yi// sgrub thabs yin te mi phan pas// nang du gnas pa la brgal te// phyi rol du 'chor bas 'chi bar 'gyur// nan tan chen pos bsgoms pa las// thabs gzhan yod pa ma mthong lags// //gnyid log pas khams ldog pa'i rgyu gang yin mi ldog pa'i thabs ji ltar bya snyam na/ nad rnams 'tsho byed sman pa yis// sa yi khams dang me yi khams// skyes pa tshad par gyur par 'dod// de la chu dang rlung gis snyoms// nyon mongs gti mug gnyid log pas// gnod pa bskyed cing ldog par 'gyur// dri med 'od gsal chos kyi sku// ting 'dzin bdag pos dbang byas pas// dkar phyogs dge ba'i rtsa ba yis// gnod pa mi mthun phyogs kun bzlog /gang la ji ltar gnod pa 'di// rdzas kyi dngos po 'dod gyur na// mi 'dod sman gyi rnam pa dang*// gnyis su med par byas la gtang*// mthon dman cha chu'i rim pa yis// snyoms par gyur na de la bzhag

/'di yang zab pa'i gdams ngag go/ //mi tshe ring por bsgoms bsgoms pas skyon med yon tan ma byung na de'i rgyu dang*/ yon tan bskyed pa'i thabs ji ltar bya snyam na/ yul gang la mnyam par bzhag pa yis// nyes dang yon tan du ma 'byung*// de nyid gang yin shes par bya// bde legs yon tan du ma rnams// ting 'dzin nyon mongasa'abrang*// don dam 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// rang gis rtogs pas 'khor ba spong*// //mi mthun pa'i skyon sna tshogs la skyon sel thabs sna tshogs yod dam snyam na/ bar du gcod pa gsum la sogs// nyes pa mi mthun phyogs rnams la// gdams ngag tshig tshogs spros pa yis// cung zad phan par mi 'gyur te// mdor bsdus kun rdzob don dam gyi// sems gnyis nor bu rin po che// bye brag lam du btang ba dang*// chos lnga dag la 'bad par bya// zla ba gza' las thar ba ltar// nyes pa'i skyon las grol bar 'gyur// gal te nyams su blangs pa las// skyon las thar bar ma gyur na// bla ma dam pa lhag pa'i lha// rgyal ba sras bcas thams cad kyis// bslus par 'gyur te 'di las med// theg chen gsang sngags rgyud rnams su// bskyed rdzogs gnyis kyis skyon sel zhing*// yon tan sgrub pa med pa na// bu gcig rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// 'di las gzhan pa'i gdams ngag dang*// man chung yig chung bsags gyur kyang*// rang gzhan gang la ma phan pa// rang gis nyams su myong bas grub// //bla ma rnam pa bzhi khams kyi tshul lugs gcig pa yin gsungs pa de gang yin snyam na/ bla ma la stod dmar po dang*// lo ro 'tshal pa nga 'bu bzhi// khams gcig ces smras pa gang yin pa// gcig shos kyi khams su gcig pa yin// bla ma chen po 'tshal pa de// de kho na bzhin du bzhugs zhad gda'// khong sangs rgyas bstan pa thugs su song*// bstan pa dar bar byed pa la// gzhi gtsug lag khang dang mi mthun phyogs// gnod par byed pa'i phrin las kyis// gsad dang 'gar dang 'jigs par byed// thugs dang po'i sa bon gang yin de// zab pa'i chos kyis dbang bsgyur bas// rlabs chen ོda pa 'grub pa yin// ngas ni sdang byed dgra rnams dang*// gnod byed bgegs kyi gtso byas pa'i// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can la// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// ci byed khong gi don du bsngos// gar phyin gar 'dug thams cad du// mi min gdug pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// mang rje drug tsha la sogs pa// gdug pa can gyi mi tshogs rnams// legs par dul nas mthun rkyen sgrub//

//byams snying rje bsgoms pas gnod pa 'byung ba'i skabs gda'/ de'i tshul lugs gang yin snyam na/ byams dang snying rje bsgoms pa yis// nyes pa'i skyon rnams slongs pa'i tshe// rgyud chad med pa'i sbyor ba yis// dngos grub phun sum tshogs par 'gyur// badz+ra yo ga'i bsgrub pa la// 'bras bu skyon du 'gyur ba dang*// dngos grub thob pa'i khyad par ltos// //nyon mongs gsum khyad par du zhe sdang che na nyams len gyi gnad ji ltar bya snyam na/ rang rgyud la skyes pa'i nyon mongs gsum// khyad par zhe sdang drag po yis// 'khrugs pas yul dang 'dres pa yis// rtags dang mtshan ma byung ba'i tshe// sdig dang dge ba'i grogs po yis// tha dad lam du khrid gyur pas// dbang po rab kyi nyams len gyis// byams dang snying rje'i stobs 'phel ba'i// zhe sdang ri bo chen pos kyang*// snying rje'i mkhal ba sleb mi nus// bla med byang chub sems gnyis kyis// 'gro ba smin par byed pa 'di// bla med gsang sngags chen po ste// sku gsung thugs kyi sbyor ba rnams// 'dzin par byed pa'i bdag por 'gyur// dbyer med gcig tu ma gyur cing*// tha dad gyur pas rgyal ba yi// zhing du skye bar gyur na yang*// nad dang gnod pa nyes pa yis// rgyun du 'tsho bar 'gyur ba dang*// 'gro ba'i mig tu mi sdug cing*// gshe zhing smad pa'i gnas su 'gyur// shin tu zhan pas sangs rgyas kyi// rigs su sems bskyed gcig pa'i phyir// mi bzad 'jigs pa'i skur bstan te// gsad dang 'gar dang mnan la sogs// phrin las sna tshogs du ma yis// rim gyis bla med sa la 'god// //nyams su blang ba'i rim pa skad skad cig yod dam snyam na/ ting 'dzin gcig la mnyam bzhag cing*// myong ba skyes par gyur pa'i tshe// snang mdzad kun tu zhal bzhin du// nyams len yul la bye brag med// shin tu dma' ba'i sbyor ba yis// dpal ldan 'bri ba chen po yis// yon tan bskyed pa'i gnad cig gi

/myong ba skyes pa gsang bar bya// lha 'dre thams cad mi dga' bas// sne'u zur pa'i yig 'phrin de// nye gnas kyis bltas pas ko long byung*// 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa dag /de dag kun la khyad par med// //sgrub pa byed pa la bar chad mi 'byung ba srid dam snyam na/ sgrub pa nan tan byas gyur na// bar chad mi 'byung mi srid pas// dngos grub bar chad rang dbang che// lhan cig skyes pas dbang byas pas// rang nyid ye shes he ru kaḥ /gzhan du ci 'dod bsgrub byed pa// gnod sbyin ngo bo gcig tu mchi// chos 'di gsang ba yin mod kyang*// na so rgas pas khyed la bstan// mthar thug shes rab chen po gang*// 'khor bar skye byed shas che bas// sems skad cig gnas par mi gtub ste// phyi rol yul la zhen pa des// khug cing gnas pas zin par 'gyur// de dang 'dra bar gzhan la yang*// don 'di nges par 'dri bar 'gyur// //shes rgyud tha dad pas gzhan la gnod pa bsgrubs pas rang nyid la gnod pa 'byung ba yin snyam na/ snang ba rang gi sems yin pas// pha rol rtag par 'dod pa'i blo// sems can rnams kyi srog gcod pa// de nyid rang nyid yin pa yi// sems can dmyal bar 'gro bar 'gyur// gnas der sdug bsngal sna tshogs la// gshin rje'i skyes bu rnams kyis bsgrub// log par lta ba gzhir gyur pas// log par gyur te gnod pa 'byung*// gnod pa'i lan du gnod pa bskyal// ji bzhin rgyu 'bras lags mod kyang*// phan pa bsgrubs pas gnod pa de// log lta'i 'bras bu yin par nges// //nged gsum mkha' 'gro mas gdan 'dren pa la kho 'tshal pas nga rten 'brel la dbang bsgyur bas mi 'gro ste 'ong zhes pa de ci yin snyam na/ bstod pa chen po gsungs pa des// phag mo gru ru byon nas kyang*// zhogs pa nang du bzhugs pa'i tshe// dbu rgyan gnas nas sun ma byung*// rten 'brel mdzad pas bzhugs par gyur// de yi gdams ngag zhus pa las// de cung zad bzla bar mi btub ste// 'on kyang khyod la phyogs tsam bstan// rang nyid dpal ldan he ru kaḥ

/bsgoms pas mkha' 'gro'i bdag por 'gyur// 'khor 'das dbyer med de yi srog /bar chad dang po mi 'byung zhing*// byung ba rnams kyang bzlog pa yin// dpal ldan bde mchog la sogs pa'i// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thams cad kun// shin tu yod pa'i rigs su gda'// rang nyid de ltar bsgoms byas pas// de dang 'dra ba'i go 'phang thob// 'di gang yang 'gal bar gyur pa med// gtso bo sems dang sems las byung*// de nyid 'khor du gyur pa'i phyir// tha ma 'gyur zhing 'jam dbyangs dang*// gshin rje gshed la 'gal ba med// gal te kha gdong gtsor gyur na// de nyid zhal gyi rnam par 'gyur// bde stong yab dang yum gyur de// lha mo thams cad skur mthong bas// bde chen rgyas pa'i yon tan 'byung*// //zhe sdang med kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis mda' gzhu la reg par ma gnang ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ sems kyis lus dang snang ba dag /byin gyis brlab par 'gyur ba'i phyir/ dge dang mi dge'i 'bras bu dag /'byung bar nges pas mda' gzhu las// brten pa'i zhe sdang gdug sems 'byung*// de yi las kyi rnam smin gyis// sdug bsngal ci phyir 'byung mi 'gyur// pha bsad gcig pus mtshams med ces// gzhan mi nus te bar skabs med// mnar sems rgyud chad med ces pa// thub pa chen pos bka' stsal to// nga yis brdegs dang gshe ba la// 'bras bu mi 'byung ma yin te// phan dang bde ba'i bsam pa yis// 'gro ba'i rgyal por cis mi 'gyur// de phyir sna tshogs snang ba rnams// rtog pa'i bye brag tha dad las// 'byung ba de kho na nyid do// //zhabs drung dang ri khrod gcig gam snyam na/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs drung du// go bas ri khrod gtan la 'bebs// ri khrod dgos par ngo shes pa// zhi gnas la gnas lhag mthong dang*// lhag mthong la gnas zhi gnas kyis// mnyam pa'ang khams kyis 'gro zhes gsung*//

//nad dang gnod pa la dang po byin rlabs byas pas bde ba la/ de nas log byung na ci yin snyam na/ 'di shin tu zab pa'i gdam ngag ste// mthar thug byin rlabs chen po yis// dang po lhan gyis bde bar 'gyur// cung zad de rgyun bsrings byas pas// nyes kun slong nas sdug bsngal 'byung*// dpe dri ma langs pa lta bu yin// de rgyun cung zad bsrings pa yis// yon tan rgya mtsho dpungs kyis 'gyur// 'di la mgon pos lung bstan pas// yongs su 'dzin pa'i bshes gnyen gyis// mtshan nyid dpag tu med pa gsungs// //ci+i tsam brtson 'grus byas pa tsam gyis khams ngan par 'ong bar 'dug pa la ji ltar bya snyam na/ snod bcud du 'dzin pa bzlog pa'i phyir// 'byung ba rim rtsegs gsung na yang*// nyan thos rang rgyal yin pa'i phyir// yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyis// 'od zer spros pas sems can gyi// sdig dang sgrib pa bsal nas kyang*// yi dam lha ru gyur pa las// 'od zer tshur 'dus rang la thim// de las gyur pa'i dkyil 'khor du// bsgoms pas des kyang sems can gyi// ma lus rgya chen don 'byung ste// 'di byang chub sems kyi rgyu 'bras yin// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad la// 'od zer med pas 'gro ba kun// smin cing grol bar byas pa med// rab gnas la sogs gsang sngags kyi// phrin las kun gyi rtsa ba yin// //dam pa rgya gar gyi zhi byed du// nad dang sdug bsngal byung gyur na// rig pa rten dang phral zhes gsung*// jo bo chen po lha cig gis// dngos po cig la gzhug ces gsung*// jo mo lab sgron gdam ngag las// thabs lam nam mkha' sgo 'byed yod// pha 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// zab mo rten 'brel mnga' ba de// zab mo lus ngag yid gsum la// rtsol bsgrub 'bad rtsol byas pa yis// bde ba ma yin sdug bsngal 'byung*// rlung ldang 'jug gnyis kyis sbyor ba des// gshis la gnas pa med pas so// 'di la tsha tsha 'debs pa dang*// chu gtor gtong ba la sogs pa// dkar phyogs dge bas yon tan 'phel// e ma ngo mtshar mi che'am/// /

bla ma la ji ltar 'bul ba byas pa ltar/ slob ma la yang de bzhin du 'ong bar 'gyur bas/ dpal ldan mar pa lho brag pas// rje btsun chen po'i zhabs tog la// brtags kyang rten 'brel ma mdzad la// 'dir chu'am nas sam me tog gis// legs par bkang nas dkar rdzis byung*// bkra shis shing gi steng bzhag nas// bzlog pa'i thabs la mkhas pa yin// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// bzang po lta bur snang bas kyang*// dngos po ngan pas 'bab pa yi// na zhing 'chi bar 'gyur nges pas// bu kun rdzob snang ba ban bun la// ji ltar byas pa'i 'bras bu de// bzang ngan khyad med rnam smin 'byung*// 'di chos rje bla ma rin chen gyi// phyag bzhes rten 'brel zab mo lags// //mdze nad la byams snying rje med par lha bsgoms pas phan nam snyam na/ 'jigs su rung ba'i gnod pa de// chu bdag 'khor bcas kyis byas pa min// zhe sdang gdug pa'i nga rgyal des// khro bo chen por bsgoms na yang*// rang nyid la brub ka byas par zad// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyis// gnas skabs mthar thug ma lus pa'i// bde skyid yon tan kun 'byung bas// zhag dang zla ba 'ga' res kyang*// nyes pa'i skyon las grol bar 'gyur// 'di ngo mtshar bas kyang rmad du byung*// //dus mchod bzhi bsod nams che ba'i rgyu mtshan ci yin snyam na/ shin tu gnyan pa'i dus tshod der// nyon mongs rnam par rtog pa'i tshogs// nyes kun rnam par 'dzoms par 'gyur// bod khams skyong ba'i bstan ma rnams// u rgyan rgyal pos btul ba yis// dam tshig bdar bas las rnams grub// gti mug wa ra ṇa sīr te// e la'i 'dab sogs klu rnams dang*// mnyan du yod pa zhe sdang ste// gnod sbyin gdug pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// byang chub snying por 'dod chags te// bdud kyi sde rnams btul ba yi// chos skyong srung ma chen por bzhugs// khyad par de dang gzhan yang 'dra// de phyir dus kya// mi shes gti mug dbang gyur pas// khams gsum 'khor ba sdug bsngal myong*// rtogs pa'i gang zag de nyid la// mi dger gyur pa gang yang med// de yang byang chub chen por bsngo// rtogs par ma gyur go bas kyang*// srid pa nus med du btang ba yin// mtshan nyid pha rol phyin pa dang*// gsang sngags theg pa khyad par med// bla na med pa 'dod chags la// dga' ba bzhi dang skad cig bzhi// bcu drug byas pas 'grub mi 'gyur// tha mal phung po'i gnyen po de// yi dam lha nyid yin gyur kyang*// ril po gcig 'dzin gyi shes pa de// dben pa khams dang skye mched sogs// 'khor lo'i bye brag mtha' yas 'gyur// ngag dang sems kyang de bzhin no// gti mug gdod nas yod ma myong*// bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// mi shes 'khor ba'i 'byung khungs la// rnam dag btsal bas 'grub mi 'gyur//

//rje gong ma'i zhal nas// dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i zhal mthong na// 'jigs su rung ba'i klu 'byung ba// de nyid de ru 'gyur ba de// gang mi 'dod pa 'byung lags pa// dngos grub 'byung ba'i mtshan nyid yin// 'on kyang klu nyid gsungs pa de// gang zag gi rigs la dgongs pa lags// //dur khrod la sogs pa'i gnas kyis dngos grub nye ba'am/ che ba yin nam snyam na/ 'jigs shing nyam nga'i gnas rnams su// rnal 'byor rab 'bring tha ma yi// rim pas srog gi bar chad dang*// dngos grub yon tan du ma ster// don lung ma bstan du 'ong ba yin// //dmu chu la sogs pa'i nad chen po la sogs pas bsod nams chen por byung na/ de ji ltar yin snyam na/ 'jigs dang sdug bsngal med pa yi// chu bo'i rlabs bzhin 'phyo bas na// snang ba dgra yi 'du shes skye// nyon mongs sred pa'i mthu stobs kyis// rang lus rgyas shing gang ba'i tshe// dug gsum 'bar bas// thub pa chen po 'od bsrungs nas// mkhyen bzhin bzhugs dang 'byon pa dang*// bltams dang rdzogs sangs rgyas pa yin// dmigs dang rang bzhin thams cad la// nor ma nor go bar byung na ni// rdo rje 'chang chen bcom ldan yin// //char 'bebs pa'i gnad gang yin snyam na/ 'jig rten khams kyi sems can rnams// las mi dge drag pos dbang byas pas// char chu dus su mi 'bab cing*// nyes pa rnam pa sna tshogs 'byung*// byams dang snying rjer ldan pa yis// skyes bu chen po cig yod pas// phrin las bsgrubs pas char pa 'bab// dpal gyi lha mo'i dam tshig gis// klu dang sa yi+i snying po yi// thug dam rgyud bskul de nas 'byung*// chos lnga dag la 'bad byas na// de las 'byung bar nges pa ste// snang ba rang gi sems kyi phyir// byams pa chen po'i mthu stobs kyis// mi mthun rkyen las skyes pa yi// rig pa ngar dang ldan pa'i tshe// lha dbang lha min 'joms pa dang*// bden pa'i tshogs rnams 'grub pa dang*// de las skyes pa 'byung ba dang*// byams pa chen po sngon 'gro ba'i// 'jig rten dbang po'i klong zhesas pas don 'grub pa ji ltar yin snyam na// rta brgya phul bar gyur pa bsad// de na 'ongs pa de nyid thob// go ba skyes pas rtogs pa phul// de las logs su 'khor 'das med// des ma phul med de stong gsum 'di// gser gyis bkang ba'i do ma yin// 'khor los bsgyur rgyal tshe gcig gis// gling bzhi la dbang zhing sa kun// 'bad pas rang 'tsho tsam las med// 'di rnam dag 'gres su go bar mdzod//

//sngags kyi grangs kyis phan nam snyam na/ kha cig bsgoms kyang mi phan zhing*// kha cig yengs bas gzhan la phan// sngags kyi de nyid ma shes na// bzlas pa don med go bar bya// //rten rnying pa'am/ lha 'dres bzung ba'i rab gnas byed na ji ltar bya snyam na/ lha 'dres be gter dang mdzod// 'dod par bsams nas de gtad do// gang ltar byas kyang bdag nyid la// grib skyon byung bas phan pa la// gnod par mi 'gyur bdag bsrung ba// nyams len rim pa ji lta ba'o// des na rgyal po bla ma dag /bdag la ngo mnyam shes par bya// //bskyed rim la brtan pa thob kyang*/ 'drer skyes pa dang gnod pa bskyed pa dang phan pa mi 'byung ba'i rgyu ci yin snyam na/ byang chub sems las skyes pa yis// gsang sngags bskyed pa'i rim pa la// mtshams sbyor gzhan gyis byas gyur na// de 'gyur dpung dang stobs med pas// sbyor ba'i gnad 'di shes nas kyang*// lha yi bar chad cung zad de// cis kyang 'byung ste lta ba yis// thag bcad dge dang mi dge'am// btang snyoms bde sdug la sogs pa// sku gsung thugs kyi nges pa bskyed// 'dis ni cung zad mi gnyan par// go rtogs ldan pas shes par bya// //rtsa dang 'khor lo'i grangs mang nyung zab pa yin nam snyam na ma yin te/ rtsa yi gnas lugs mi gtso ste// rang gi bsam pas bsgyur ba'i phyir// lam gyi rim pa gsum du go// des na 'du shes gtso shes bya// g.yos la mkhas pa ltar bcas pa// dge ba mi 'dod gang yang med// de gzhan gyi dbang du mi btang bar// bdag nyid kyis ni bsgrub par bya// 'di babs la gnas na gdams ngag go/ //sdig pa bshags pa dang 'dag pa'i rgyu mtshan gang yin snyam na/ sa bon rnam par shes pa gang*// des khyad par du byas pa lus ngag las// las de sems las 'u phra ba'i rnam pa yis// gnas lugs kyi ngang du lhan gyis zhi// mda' gzhu lta bu'i sbyor ba yis// rgya mtsho chen po'i pha rol brgal// me dpung 'bar ba chen po yis// dngos po ma lus thal bar brlag

/'bar ba'i mgo bo mi bzad pas// steng gi chu rgyun 'bab pa gcod// rgya mtsho chen por bying ba'i tshe// rnam dag nam mkha'i mthong khung dbye// cis kyang mi phan 'chi gyur na// nges par 'pho ba'i gdam ngag brtsam// tshe zad pa'i mtha' ru mi phyin na// rtsa rlon lag pas dkrugs pa ltar// smyo 'bog snying rlung gi gnod pa 'byung*// tshe dang las zad mthar thug na// chu khams zad pa'i rtsa dang 'dra// 'di brgyud pa'i gdams ngag nying khu yin// rgan po mdze po rten zhan la// btsan thabs kyi 'pho ba gsungs pa de// nges par sdug grir shi bas na// rab tu byung bas mi bya gsung*// gnad lnga dang ldan pa'i 'pho ba 'di// khyad par kun las 'phags pa'i phyir// yul dang bsam pa rtsa dang rlung*// dus kyi gnad kyis tshegs med par// dpal rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang thob// //gnas las byung ba'i grib sel gyi// gdams pa dpag med gsungs na yang*// thal tshan chu grang gi sbyor ba dang*// rim cig bri dang bstan par bya// bdag gis ting 'dzin rtsed mo yis// brag la mi mthun phyogs rnams 'phos// de la me yi sbyor ba byas// 'byung ba bzhi po 'dra bar gda'// nges par pha phogs yin pa'i phyir// cis kyang 'byung bar nges pas na// ting nge 'dzin gyis lam bar dang mthar dge gang*// dang por dge ba bar dang mthar// dge ba gcig pur 'gyur ba 'di// myong ba can gyi dam chos yin// //rdzas kyi rten 'brel shes pa de mchog yin nam snyam na/ phyi rol rten 'brel ma lus pa// mo bon ju yag dang khyad par med// bdag la lo gsum bar du byung*// bdag ni shin tu gsang dam pas// phyi rol du ma shor bsam pa'i gnad// mi rtag rten 'brel go ba'i phyir// thub pa'i gsung rab thams cad kyis// dam pa'i chos su phebs pa yin// rlung gi stobs kyis bsal ba las// skyon dang yon tan gang yang min/ /snang zhing shes pa de dag kun// mkhyen pa'i ye shes khyad par med// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho de// phyag rgya chen por yong ba las// rdzu 'phrul rtags dang mtshan mas min// 'di bon pos skyug log yi chad lags//
