//rang gi 'khor gces pa snying por gyur pa tshe ring bar 'dod na ji ltar bya snyam na/ rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs skyong ba'i// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po rnams// rang dang 'khor rnams tshe ring zhing*// bkra shis bde legs 'byung ba dang*// khyad par bar chad med 'dod na// rang bskyed rim brtan pa gzhir bzhag pas// ma 'ongs 'byung ba yi dam lhar// bsgoms pas mthong tshad lhar 'gyur lags/ khyad par gces pa de bzhin no// //srog thig ler gzhug pa'i man ngag ni// nad dang sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*// ting 'dzin bzang po skye 'dod pas// dang por nyon mongs lam du btang*// de rjes byang chub sems las byung ba yi// khams gsum bdag po chen po yis// 'od ma 'grim pa lta bu la// iu ni la mtshan gyi 'od// 'bar ba rtsa ba lta bur bsgom// rlung a wa Zà tīr tshud gyur pas// mtha' dbus med par bde chen 'bar// sems ni gzugs kyi khams nyid de// 'od gsal khams gsum ngo bo nyid// de rgyun chad med par bskyang bar bya// //gzhan gyis gnod pa byas pa la byams snying rje bsgoms pas de 'chi ba nges par 'dug pas mi 'chi ba'i thabs yod dam snyam na/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs gyur pas// phan dang gnod pa 'byung ba dang*// byams dang snying brtse yod par gcig /nges par phung bar gyur pa yin// ma 'ongs dus su thugs rjes bzung*// de las gzhan pa'i gdams ngag med// ma bsgoms dus su 'byung ba de// dam chos phyag rgya chen po yin// bsgoms pas nyams su myong ba de// rnal 'byor ting 'dzin kha zas yin// gzhan don bsgoms pas 'byung ba'i phyir// mi mthun bsal bas bcos par bya// bde ba 'gro ba thams cad 'dren// mi rtog ting 'dzin skye ba'i gnas// phyi rol yul la dmigs pa de// 'phros pas rgyal ba'i thugs dam bskang*// stong nyid ngang du gnas pa de// bsdus pas yum gyi mkha' la 'khyil// 'di 'gro ba'i don phyir de bzhin gshegs//

//tshad med bzhi sems can gyi dus na gang yin pa dang*/ yon tan ci skye snyam na/ byams pas sems kyi rnam par gdungs// yi mug snying rje chen po nyid// dga' ba yul la 'dod cing chags// btang snyoms rnam pa gsum du 'dod// kun khyab byams pa chen po'i sems// de yi rje 'brangs sems las byung*// yon tan sgrub pa man ngag gnad// snying rje gnod pa'i sgor gyur pas// gshe dang brdeg dang 'jigs par byed// dbang ni 'dod pa'i gnas gyur pa// de bas lhag pa yod pa'i phyir// de yi rdzas kyi sbyor ba rnams// dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang gis gsungs// bde gshegs rigs lnga'i dngos grub kun// dbyer med rang bzhin gyis len gyur pas// phyi ni dga' zhing nyams bde ste// nang gi dngos grub de nyid kyang*// bdag nyid gcig pa'i 'brel pa yis// don rtsa ba'i rdzas kyi gnad du nges// //phyag rgya chen po'i khrid ma gtogs pa'i bskyed pa'i thabs yod dam snyam na/ sbyor ba'i chos kyi dbang byas pa'i// bden pa gnyis kyis man ngag dang*// thun 'jog a ro la sogs pa// khong rang grub mtha'i bye brag rnams// bsgoms par gyur pa'i dus gcig na// ngo sprod byas pas chog pa yi// gcig tu 'dre ba'i dus gnas yod// nyams skyes pa 'dag par nus pa yi// rdo rje 'chang chen bla ma dgos// 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa lags// //rin po che'i bu slob la/ rnam par thar pa dang rtogs pa tha dad par 'ong bar 'dug pa de la jayang*// 'bras bu thob pa'i dus med pas// grangs med bskal pas ga la phan// grub mtha' tha dad sna tshogs pa// bzung na yon tan mi skye bas// sems rtogs pa'i gang zag min pa med// rtogs pa de nyid gzhir gyur pa'i// yul gyi dngos po rtogs pa yi// bye brag mtha' yas tshad med pas// e ma rnam thar bsam mi khyab// de ltar bltas pas yon tan gyi// phung po chen po khyed la skyes// sde 'khrug byas pa'i gnas la sogs// grib kyis sems la phog gyur cing*// shing skam dang 'dra bar gyur pa las// snang ba zil gnon gyi gdams ngag dgos// 'di la dkon mchog gsum gyi rten// tsha tsha 'debs pa la sogs dang*// thub pas gsungs shing byin rlabs pa// zab mo'i mdo sde bsgrags pa dang*// dge slong bzhi sde la sogs par// byin gyis brlab par zhu ba 'di// phyi yi rten cing 'brel pa yin// nang ting nge 'dzin gyi bye brag ni// thabs dang shes rab kyi bogs 'don gyi// man ngag la brten zab mo'i rlung*// bcom ldan 'das kyis dbu snyung bzhes// sems las su cung zad rung ba'i tshe// zhe sdang 'pho ba'i byed las gcig

/gnyis kas 'chi bar byed pa yin// slob ma rnams la gdams pa de// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug la// zhe sdang gis ni mthar byed 'gyur// 'dir yang 'dod pa'i yul de ru// zhe sdang gi de yi lus su 'gyur// //dang po bsod nams byung nas phyis bsod nams chung ba de rgyu gang yin snyam na/ dran dang shes bzhin bag yod dang*// chog shes nor rnams don gcig phyir// snga ma'i thog tu ma gnas nas// phyi ma 'dod pa'i skyon gyis 'byung*// snga ma de nyid chog shes na// yon tan ngo bo nyid kyis skye// thub pa'i dam chos ma lus pa// mi chos mdun chos zab mo yin// gshis tha dad du yod pas mi 'gyur bar// sbyor dngos gnyis po mi 'gyur yang*// rjes la 'khor ba bskyed par 'gyur// bsam pa mi dge ba'i bsam pa dang*// gnyis med dbye ba med gyur kyang*// phyi ma bsgrub byed las kyis 'byed// 'di yon tan rgya mtsho bskyed pa'i gzhi// //man ngag 'di rnams mi bzhed yang bsgoms pas phan par 'dug pa ci yin snyam na/ blo sbyong gi man ngag zab mo dang*// bdag nyid chen po'i £ ling gis// lus srog gnyis la chags zhen bral// nad dang gnod pa ldog pa de// gshis 'gyur ba med pas phan lags kyang*// don 'di sus kyang go ba med// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// 'khor lo mgo la bzod bya ba// sdug cing bsngal bar dogs pa'i sems// bzod pa'i stobs kyis zil gyis mnan// 'khor lo mkha' la 'khor ga rten mgon po'i bzhed pa yis// pha rgyud ma rgyud gnyis kyi don// bla ma'i gdams ngag rim pa yis// don 'di 'byung bar gyur pa de// zhi gnas ting 'dzin bzang po yin// de spros med 'od gsal du rtogs gyur pas// lhag mthong ting 'dzin dag pa yin// phun tshogs yon tan ma lus pa// byang chub sems las 'byung bar nges// ngan zhing brnyas par gyur pa de// bzang po yin snyam nga rgyal skye// bcud dgu ldan pa snod byas na// me yi nang du bsregs pas dri ngan byung*// gos bzang po 'dod kyang ma rnyed de// tshad med snying rje chen po yis// 'gro ba'i don phyir 'bad pa des// phun tshogs yon tan rgya mtsho byung*//

//mi'i lus dge ba bcus 'grub pa la chags sdang gis mtshams sbyar ba'i rgyu gang yin snyam na/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// las dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan// chags sdang rmongs gsum kun gyis bskyed// skye med chos skus 'khor ba spong*// byams pa byang chub sems nyid la// 'khor gsum du rtog pa ma rig pa// de dang mthun dang 'gal rkyen gnyis// chags shing sdang ba khyad par chos// 'khor ba skyed byed byed pa'i gzhi// mi gnas mya ngan 'das pa'i bdag /sangs rgyas rnams dang sems dpa' dang*// 'khor 'das thams cad 'di las byung*// 'di ni rmad du byung ba'i chos// dge sbyor la mnyam par bzhag dus su// bar chad bdud kyi tshogs 'byung ba// de nyid choms par ma gyur na// phyis kyi bkren rnying ldang bar 'gyur// bla med dbye dgon spongs pa ru// thab tu 'ong bas 'brum bu byung*// sal sil dang khrul ma byas pas ldog /'di la byang chub sems nyid dang*// chos lnga de dag yin gyur kyang*// dngos po de nyid phyag rgya che// yi dam lha ru gyur pa yis// snga ma byang zhing phyis mi 'byung*// de phyir dngos po re re yang*// rgyal ba rigs lngar gyur pa'i phyir// rigs kyi dbye ba bsam mi khyab// //phyi yul gyi dngos po nang du ting nge 'dzin bskyed par byed pa ni/ phyi rol rten 'brel ma lus pas// rang gzhan sgrub par byed pa 'di// thub pa chen pos mkhyen pa yin// bde chen skye ba'i gnas dros pas// byin rlabs ma yin ngo bo nyid// rten 'brel grub pas 'byung ba de// dpal biÄsa pa kun gyis 'du// skyu ra yon bdag nya bzang gis// ja zho lnga la yi chad de// sgrub pa byas pa zhe sdang yin// thun mong ma yin gdams pa ni// ji ltar bstan dang bshad pa dang*// lo rgyus mtho dman thams cad kun// rtsa bar gyur pa 'di las med// mi mthun gnod pa tshan chen la// gzung 'dzin byas shing bros na yang*// phyi phyir 'jigs pa chen po skye// de nyid kyi thog tu bsdad nas kyang*// lam du btang ba'i man ngag dang*// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po yis// yon tan rgya mtshor dpungs kyis 'gyur// nyon mongs dug gi dmag tshogs de// gnyen po ye shes rdo rjes 'joms// bcom ldan rdo rje 'chang chen des// khro gtum rngam pas gdug pa sgrol// kun bzang chos dbyings khyab par yang*// zhi ba'i bdag nyid lhun gyis grub// thub mchog bla ma mnyes bya'i phyir// gus pa'i bdag nyid phyi bzhin 'brang*// phyi rol yul gyi rkyen dbang gis// skyed byed bsam pa de yi lus// gcig dang du mar snang ba'o//

//lar gyi bya ba'i 'dug lugs kyis// dbyings 'di byas na bsdad pas gus stobs su 'byung*// mos pa myong ba skyes na thob// snyan cing mjeb pa'i dam pa'i chos// dpag tu med pa bshad na yang*// mos gus med par gyur pa de// shin tu skom pas gdungs pa la// me la bsten ces smras pas nyes// chu bsil 'thung zhes bstan na go// de nyid myong ba'i man ngag des// lus sems gnyis po tshim gyur nas// cis kyang phan btags drin du go// nyams myong lha la skyes pa de// rgad po rgan mo mdze mo'ang rung*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin// de cis kyang spong bar mi 'gyur ro// bu cig khyed kyi dam chos la// nan tan 'bad par bya bar rigs// ngas ni dka' las sdug bsngal gyis// chos 'di'i go ba rnyed pa yin// ngas dka' bas bsgrubs pa'i man ngag gnad// khyed la nan tan chen pos gdams// legs par g.yos pa'i kha zas la// zos pas chog pa'i dus dang 'dra// de phyir 'bad pa thams cad kyis// bsgrub la nan tan 'bad par zhu// gdams ngag man chung gi mgo bskor dang*// tshig dang tha snyad kyi spros pa la// zab cing rgya che chos kyi gnad// 'byung bar gyur pa ma yin te// tshig phreng ri bo bsnol ba'i bar// don mnyam nyid yangs pa'i yangs thang yod// ston pa'i dam chos bsdus pa'i don// 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs dgongs mchog /byang chub sems gnyis ma gtogs pa// tshig tshogs gdams ngag gi spros pa chod// bla ma rnam pa sna tshogs kyi// gdams pa tha dad sna tshogs pas// rlabs chen don du mi 'gyur te// rje gong mas thams cad phyogs sngar bzhag /nga yang gcig tu de rung 'brang*// gzhan la sna tshogs gdams pa mnga'// mkhas dang rmongs pa'i khyad par gyis// skyes chen gnyis kyis mdzad pa la// da lta khyed kyis lta bar gyis// de phyir 'jig rten mgon po yi// rjes su 'brang ba nyid du mdzod//

//lar gyi rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog la// nges par skyabs su song ba dang*// nyon mongs rnam rtog spong ba yi// tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang*// snying rje chen po las byung ba'i// byang chub sems kyi mthu stobs dang*// tshad ldan bla ma dam pa yi// dbang las byung ba'i bskyed rdzogs gnyis// sdom gsum gcig tu gyur pa yis// thog ma med pa'i 'khor ba dang*// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dang*// mi mthun bar chad bgegs kyi tshogs// bdud kyi sde rnams bcom nas kyang*// chos rje khams gsum las rgyal bar// thob par 'gyur ba the tshom med// bu de phyir dam chos shes bya la// rnam gzhag tsam du ma song bar// rang rgyud dag pa shin tu gces// thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shes rab kyis// nyon mongs las sdug bsngal 'byung ba 'di// mngon gsum du mthong zhing go na yang*// spong ba'i thabs la mi 'bad na// dgra 'byung bar shes kyang mi 'bros pas// rang nyid gsod par 'gyur dang 'dra// de phyir de nyid bsgom pa la// bsrung bzlog man ngag logs su med// gal te rkyen ngan bzlog gyur kyang*// lam dog po'i 'phrang du tshud gyur na// mnyam nyid sum gnyis sum cha yi// don ma go bas lan pa yin// mnyam dang lhag pa cis kyang dgos// de ltar nyams su blangs pa yis// gzugs snang tha dad sna tshogs pa// gnyis med ye shes phyag rgya che// tshogs drug lha yi dkyil 'khor yin// mig ni sa yi snying po ste// sdug dang mi sdug bar ma gsum// paV rdo rje sangs rgyas rigs// de nyid yum lnga'i rang bzhin te// ring dang thung dang bar ma dag /rigs gsum de nyid lngar gyur pas// bde gshegs rigs brgyar 'gyur ba yin// de dag thams cad gnyis med cing*// lhun grub sems kyi de nyid du// gcig pa rigs gcig tu grags pas// 'di ni 'bras bu mthar thug pa// sems can khams dang mnyam pas na// bsam mi khyab pa'i phrin las yin//

//de ltar 'gro mgon zhabs drung du// shākya'i dge sbyong bsod snyoms pa// rgyal sras shes rab 'byung gnas kyis// legs gsung dri med rgya mtsho'i tshogs// bsam gyis mi khyab thob na yang*// nam mkha' lta bur mtha' med phyir// dman pa'i rang blos 'dzin ma nus// brjed pas 'jigs pas bsdus pa'i don// 'khor 'das kun gyi srog snying rnams// yi ger bris par gyur pa la// bla ma mkha' 'gro ma mnyes na// thugs rje chen pos brtser dgongs te// byin gyis brlab cing bzod par bzhengs// bdag ji srid 'khor ba ma stong tshe// mnyam med bla ma rin chen dang*// skad cig tsam yang mi 'bral zhing*// mnyes pa dam pas mnyes par shog /bdag chos dbyings zhing khams ma lus par// rnam 'phrul bsam gyis mi khyab rnams// sgrib pa med par mthong ba dang*// dge ba mtha' dag bsgrub par shog /bdag dri med gsungs pa'i dam chos la// spobs pa phun sum tshogs pa dang*// mi shes rmongs pa'i sems can kun// bdud rtsis tshim par byed par shog /bdag nam mkha' mdzod la dbang bsgyur zhing*// bsod nams mi g.yo lhun po yis// skye 'gro nye bar 'tsho ba dang*// mthar phyin rtag pa'i sa thob shog /bdag mthar thug stobs bcu la gnas shing*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das kyis// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa des// bdag dang sems can ma lus pa// bla med byang chub myur thob shog /rje 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje rin po che'i zhal gyi bdud rtsi dri ma med pa'i snying po zhes bya ba rdzogs so// // 822)

༄// thabs lam gnad bdun ma// bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen la phyag 'tshal lo// de la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa gcig bka' bstsal pa las/ theg pa che chung gnyis su 'dus la/ de la theg pa chen po la gnyis te/ pha rol tu phyin pa dang gsang sngags so// gsang sngags la rgyud sde bzhi/ de la rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud/ de'i don hril gyis dril nas nyams su len pa la/ zab pa rtsa rlung thig le gsum yin par gsungs so// de las rtsa rlung byang sems kyi gnad 'di la don bdun te/ sgrub pa po gang zag gi gnad/ dus khyad par can gyi gnad/ gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i gnad/ dbang du bya ba byang chub sems bskyed kyi gnad/ gsol ba gdab pa bla ma'i gnad/ dngos gzhi nyams su blang pa'i gnad/ de'i bral 'bras kyi gnad do// de'i dang po ni/ chags grol gnyis gang yin yang/ lus phun sum tshogs pa dbang po sgo lnga la skyon med pa/ na tshod dar la bab pa snying stobs che ba/ skad gcig la sangs rgya bar 'dod pa zhig gis nyams su blang bar bya ba yin no// gnyis pa/ dus kyi gnad ni gtum mo 'bar 'dzag la gnad du song bas 'dod chags skyes pa'i dus dang*/ khyad par du nya stong la sogs pa'i dus bzhi dang*/ bud med mthong ba la chags pa drag po skyes pa'i dus su gnad du bsnun no// gsum pa/ gnas ri khrod dam dgon pa dben pa sgra'i ku co dang mi tshogs g.yeng ba med pa shin tu dben pa gal che ba yin no// bzhi pa/ sems bskyed kyi gnad ni/ gang nyams su len pa'i sngon du/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du rtsa rlung byang sems la gnad du bsnun par bya snyam du dar cig bsgom/ des dbang byas pa'i rtog pa thams di la rag las/ drug pa/

nyams su len pa'i gnad la gsum ste/ rtsa'i ngo bo gang yin pa dang*/ rlung gi ngo bo gang yin pa dang*/ byams sems kyi ngo bo gang yin pa'o// dang po rtsa la mang yang gsum po 'dir 'dus pa yin te/ g.yas ro ma nas khrag 'bab/ g.yon rkyang ma nas dri chu 'bab/ dbus dbu ma nas byang sems 'bab/ de la lus dkyil krung bcas nas drang por bsrang bas/ rtsa drang por gnas par 'gyur bas/ a ba Zà ti la gnad du bsnun pa 'di shin tu zab par 'ong ste/ de ltar yang*/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas/ a ba Zà tī'i stong ra 'di// stong ra'i nang nas mchog tu gsungs// ces so// gnyis pa rlung la mang yang gsum du 'dus pa yin/ sna bug g.yas nas rgyu ba'i rlung de rtsol ba zhes bya ste sdug bsngal bskyed par byed do// g.yon nas rgyu ba'i rlung srog zhes bya ste/ bde ba ster bar byed do// cha mnyam du rgyu ba de ye shes kyi rlung yin te/ de la gnad du bsnun pas yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa bskyed par byed do// de ltar yang slob dpon a4 de ba'i zhal snga nas/ rlung gi de nyid rab rtogs nas// sems kyi de nyid rtogs par 'gyur// zhes so// gsum pa byang sems ni/ 'dod chags chen po skyes pa'i dus su/ skyes pa dang bud med dang dud 'gro dang*/ de rnams la rang dbang med par 'dzing snying 'dod pa 'byung ste/ de la byang sems zer/ chags pa de nyid la gsang sngags nas bde ba zer bas/ pha rol tu phyin pa nas 'dod chags sam nyon mongs pa zer bas/ lam nye ring gi khyad par yang de yin/ de la gnad du byed pa la gsum ste/ rab kyi phyag rgya chen por ngo sprad pa dang*/ 'bring gis dngos grugs su bsgoms te/ 'dod chags kyi rtog pa de shor na/ dngos grub shor ba yin pas 'bad pa chen pos nyams su blang ngo*// gsum pa gegs sel bya ba ni/ rnal 'byor pa rlung bsgoms pa'i dus su rtsa mo rtsar/

rlung pho rlung zhugs pas tha mal pa'i 'dod chags pas kyang bcu drug char yang mi phod pa'i chags pa tshugs thabs med pa skyes pa'i dus su bsgom pa yin te/ de la dang po rlung la 'di ltar byang bar bya ste/ lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gtum mo ltar ram/ yang na dkyil krung du byas la/ 'og sgo 'khor ba'i rgyun thag gcad pa zhes bya ste/ sgro bshang gnyis kyi bar rus pa'i steng na byang sems rgyu ba'i rtsa yod pas/ rkang pa'i rting pas tsir gyis mnan/ lag pa'i mthe bong gnyis kyis srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan cing khu tshur bcangs te 'khyud pa'i tshul du bya/ rkang pa'i sor mo rgyu zhabs su bskum par bya'o// de nas rlung gi gnad dang sems kyi dmigs pa ni/ rtsa dbu ma gsal gdab/ gsang gnas rdo rje'i rtsa bar hūṃ dkar po zhig bsams la/ ngag tu hūṃ zhes ring ba dang*/ hūṃ zhes thung ba'i dus su hūṃ gis sbyong byas la rjes sam skabs su lus kyi 'khrul 'khor gyis rlung dang byang sems lus la khengs par bya'o// de ltar yang yang sbyangs pas/ 'byongs pa'i rtags rgyun je chung je chung rgyun 'chad/ ma chad kyang nyung du 'gro/ rdo rje sbubs su nub/ thig le phyir lan gcig kyang mi 'chor ro// de nas 'dod chags tshan po che skyes pa'i dus su// gong ltar lus kyi 'khrul 'khor dang*/ rlung gi byed pa dang*/ sems kyi dmigs pa gsum gyis gnad du bsnun la lus dgram zhing phyag rgya chen po bde stong mtha' dbus med pa'i ngang la 'byams su gzhug de ltar yang 'dod chags nyid kyis 'dod chags 'dag ces pa'am/ de yang rab tu mi gnas pa'i rgyud las/ rtsa ba'i bde ba gang yin pa// 'khor ba'i gnas su bsgom par bya// shes rab mchog gi mda' dag gis// rtog pa'i rgyun la rab tu 'bigs// zhes pa'o// bdun pa bral 'bras la gnyis te/ sgrib pa 'dag tshul dang phan yon dang 'bras bu thob tshul lo// dang po ni 'dod chags drag po skyes pa'i dus su/

snying rus chen po bskyed nas yang dang yang du bsgoms pas nang du rtsa mdud mang po grol te/ de'i dus su las dang nyon mongs pa dang*/ shes bya'i sgrib pa thams cad rtsa ba nas 'dag pa yin no// gnyis pa rtsa dpa' mo'i rang bzhin dang*/ rlung dpa' bo'i rang bzhin dang*/ thig le gnyis med kyi rang bzhin gnad du song ba'i tshe na/ tshe ring ba dang*/ nad nyung ba dang*/ 'khor 'du ba dang*/ rin po che'i rdzas la sogs pa thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ mngon par shes pa dang*/ rdzu 'phrul la sogs pa grub chen brgyad/ dmigs pa gang la gtad kyang gsal ba dang*/ yi dam gyi lha zhal mthong zhing*/ gsung thos pa la sogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa gnad 'di las 'byung ngo*// yang sa dang lam gyi rim pa thams cad kyang skad gcig la bgrod nas 'gro ba la thogase bas rgyud yongs su gang bas bde chen gyi yan lag dang*/ nam mkha' ltar mdzad pa'i 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pas rgyun mi 'chad pa'i yan lag dang*/ mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pas/ thabs sna tshogs kyi sgo nas gdul bya'i don mdzad pas/ nyid kyis 'gog pa med pa'i yan lag snying rjes yongs su gang ba'i yan lag go// de las byung ba'i bsod nams kyis// ma rnams bde chen myur thob shog /thabs lam gnad bdun ma rdzogs yོ// bka' rgya dang bcas pa'o// gu ha'o// 823) ༄// seng ge'i sgra sgrogs de nyid bzhi pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyis// me long gzugs brnyan gsal ba ltar// gang de de ru rtogs par byed// bde chen zung 'jug phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags snying po don gyi bcud// bde chen de nyid bzhi pa 'di// skal ldan gang gis rab bsgom na// skad gcig de la bde gshegs 'gyur// de la 'dir ni yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i chos thams cad khrid kyi rim pa yin la/ sangs rgyas bsgrub par byed pa yin mod kyis/ de'i nang nas tshe gcig lus gcig gis/

skad cig gcig la sangs rgya bar byed pa'i chos gsang sngags rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud yin/ de hril gyis dril bas/ rtsa rlung thig le gsum la 'dus te/ de ltar yang rje btsun chen po tiDི pa'i zhal snga nas/ dngos po'i gnas lugs lam dang ni// 'bras bu skye ba'i rim pa'o// zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas/ sems las gzhan pa'i sangs rgyas med// lam rtsa dang rlung las myur ba med// ces gsungs so// de la bzhi ste/ rtsa'i de nyid/ rlung gi de nyid dang*/ byang sems kyi de nyid dang*/ bde chen gyi de nyid do// de la rtsa la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de la rtsa'i de nyid lus ril ril po 'di yin/ de yi dam gyi lhar shes pas gnad du bsnun/ des rtsa thams cad dbang du byed do// yang rlung la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de gang yin na/ dran rig sna tshogs su 'gyu ba 'di rlung gi de nyid yin/ de la ma yengs par gnad du bsnun/ des rlung thams cad dbang du byed do// yang byang sems la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab ste/ de gang yin na/ phyi nang gi bde ba de byang sems kyi de nyid yin/ de la bde chen lam slongs kyis gnad du bsnun/ des thig le thams cad dbang du byed do// bde chen la dbye na bsam gyis mi khyab te/ de gang yin na bde stong zung 'jug gi de nyid yin/ de la zung 'jug gis gnad du bsnun/ des zung 'jug bsam gyis mi khyab par 'gyur ro// de ltar na phyi 'dod yon lam du khyer bas/ nang gi bde ba cher 'bar ba ste/ bde chen du nyams su myong dgos/ de ltar myong na tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba'am/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor pa bya ba yin/ yang bde ba ltar gyis rgyas pa'i dus su/ phyag rgya chen por phril gyis bsgom/ stong pa la'ang bde bas bsnun la bsgom/ de ltar bde stong zung 'jug la nyams su blangs pas/ rjes shes thams cad kyang bde chen du 'khyer ro// de ltar ma shes na lus thig le'i gong bur song yang dgos pa med la/

sems nam mkha' ltar rtogs kyang sangs mi rgya/ dug lnga las mi bral ba'i phyir ro// de ltar bsgoms pas thig le rgyas te 'chor 'chor 'dra na/ bzlog pa dang dgram pa ni/ zhal las shes par bya'o// de ltar rtsa rlung thig le la gnad du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas/ skad gcig la sangs rgya/ grub thob dang*/ 'ja' tshon dang ring bsrel 'ong ba'i rgyu dang*/ mngon shes rdzu 'phrul rig pa dang*// yi dam bcu yon tan brgyad sogs dang*// sangs rgyas yon tan 'di las 'byung*// rus pa'i rgyan drug 'ong ba yang*// 'di yi gnad du shes par bya// de ltar phan yon 'phel ba'i rgyu dang*/ mi nyams par bsrung ba'i dam tshig gsum rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o// de yang chos 'di la tshogs dang gtor ma gal che ste/ rtsa'i de nyid 'di yin zhes pa dang*/ rlung gi de nyid 'di yin zhes pa dang*/ byang sems kyi de nyid 'di yin zhes pa dang*/ bde chen gyi de nyid 'di yin zhes pa la mkha' 'gro ma'i bka' rgya yod pas/ gzhan la bstan na mkha' 'gro mas snying khrag 'thung bar 'gyur ro// gsang bar bya'o// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa'i dge ba dang*/ 'di las byung ba'i bsod nams tshogs rnams des// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la 'bul// de yis 'gro rnams bde chen myur thob shog /seṅge sgra sgrags de nyid bzhi pa zhes bya ba/ rdzogs yོ// bka' rgya rim pa gsum yod do// sa ma ya tha/ ´/ 824) ༄// 'jig rten mgon po'i zab chos rnal 'byor bzhi ldan// bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe 'di la mchog gi dngos grub thob par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ bla ma rtogs pa dang ldan pa byang chub kyi sems rnam gnyis 'dres pa gcig btsal/ bla ma la sangs rgyas dngos kyi 'du shes bya zhing*/ mos pa dang gus pa rgyun mi chad par bya/ dbang po rab kyi rten gyi gang zag gis mos gus tsam las rang gi don grub nas 'ong*/ dbang po 'bring gi rten gyi gang zag gis/

maṇ+ḍal dang yi ge brgya pa'i bsnyen pa zla ba phyed tsam yan chad bya ste/ sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma/ skyugs pa dang*/ 'khru ba dang*/ gos dkar po gyon pa dang*/ lus las khrag mang po 'byung ba dang*/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab kyi khar phyin pa dang*/ rang gi steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba dang*/ nam mkha' la skas btsugs nas 'gro ba la sogs du ma 'byung*/ de'i dus su zhi gnas kyi nyams zhag gsum tsam gyi bar du btsal/ de nas bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes zhag gsum gyi bar du bskyed du gzhug de'i rjes la lhan cig skyes sbyor ram/ phyag rgya chen po btab pas cig car ba'i rten gyi gang zag gis sgom med du 'gro ba yang yod/ thod rgal ba'i rten gyi gang zag gis rang gi sems rtogs nas der rang gi sems chos skur yang go// res nyams med pa tsug 'gro ba yang 'ong*/ 'di'i rtogs pa bsha' ma bar dor 'char gsung*/ rim gyis pa la dang po rtse gcig de nas spros bral/ de nas ro gcig de nas bsgom med skye ste/ rtse gcig la yang nyams bzang ngan gsum du 'ong ste/ btab pa tsam gyis gsal yer gyis 'ong lanyams mthug pa'i dus su 'di bas bzang ba logs na med snyam pa'ang 'ong*/ rtse gcig rab la yang cig car ba dang*/ thod rgal ba dang*/ rim gyis pa dang gsum/ cig car du skye na gsal stong gi nyams la 'phel 'grib med pa 'ong*/ thod rgal du skye na mtho dman shin tu che/ rim gyis pa sgom yun ring zhing bla ma la mos gus che na myur yang mi bya/ ngan pa la mi dga' ba spang zhing rtog pa mi bsgug gsol ba mang du btab cing zab pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ kho rang gi nyams bstun pas/ ci zhig ltar la spros bral gyi rtogs pa skye/ spros bral la yang rab 'bring gsum du skye ste/ rab ni dmyal bar 'gro rgyu med sangs rgyas la 'thob rgyu yang med/ chos sku dngos 'di yin snyam zhing*/ dbang med du bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes tha ma la 'ong*/

chos kyi don dang gdams ngag gis kyang nga'i sgom 'di la ma slob snyam pa 'ong*/ 'jig rten gyi chos la blo shin tu ldog tha na rang gi gdams ngag la yang zhen pa chung*/ gdams ngag thams cad kyang rtsa ba bla ma la mos gus bsgom pa kha yar gyis chog ang snyam pa'o// gnyid kyi dus su yang rang gi sems rtogs pa de shar nas 'ong*/ spros bral 'bring po skyes tsam na dmyal bar 'gro rgyu med/ sangs rgyas la 'thob rgyu med snyam pa yang res yong res mi yong ngo*// sems skye ba med pa rtag tu shes shing bsgom/ 'di kha yar gyi chog snyam pa cung med/ nyams la mtho dman dum re 'ong*/ bla ma la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skabs su 'ong*/ phyi rol bdud kyi bar chad kyis bla ma dang grogs la the tshom za ba'ang 'ong*/ res nyams ngan pa'i dus su sgom rang la'ang the tshom za la 'di chos ji ltar yin na snyam pa'ang 'ong*/ de'i dus su bla ma dam pa gcig dang ma bral bar byas shing rang gis rtogs pa la bogs 'don dgos te/ sdug bsngal can la snying rje shin tu skyes/ chos zab zab nyan/ blta ba gleng slong bya/ bla ma la yang mos gus bcos ma tshun chod kyis bskyed/ maṇ+ḍal bya zhing gsol ba rgyun tu btab pas spros bral chen po mthar thug tu 'gyur/ bla ma'i kho bos sems kyi chod che bas des na 'di dkar po chig thub yin/ mthun pa'i chos 'di nyid yin/ 'di las bzang ba'i chos gzhan med/ spang bya spang rgyu med/ gnyen po sgom rgyu med/ rnal 'byor pa lus rgya yin/ des rgya gnyis dang sbyar zhing kho la brtan pas nges shes cher 'gro'o// dbang po 'bring yin pas phyi rol gyi bdud 'jug dogs yod de/ nga rang la 'don 'dis chog pa yin snyam pa dang*/ bla ma yang mi dgos snyam nas mos gus logs pas rgyu 'bras la yang mi 'dzem/ snying rje dang dad pa yang je chung la 'gro nas nag po kha 'byams du 'gro ba'i dogs kyang yod/

de ltar song na rtogs pa la bogs mi thon/ bsgyur ba yang mang*/ rang re yang nyes pa la 'jug bdud kyi lcags kyus zin dogs yod pas bla ma dam pa'i ngag sman bzhin du bkur ro// spros bral tha ma ni sems rang ngo shes tsam rtog pa ma grub par shes/ myong ba nang du ma grub par mi shes/ rang gi sems la bag tsam 'thob kyang*/ chos zab pa dang rgya che ba bltaso che dang rang gi rtog pa gsum la yang dang yang du nges shes khyad par can bskyed/ smra bcad 'am dben par bsdad/ gsol ba drag tu btab de ltar byas nas skad cig gis bog thon no// spros bral rang la yang cig car dang thod rgal dang rim gyis dang gsum du gnas te/ cig car ni dang po rang nas spros bral mthar thug pa 'char/ thod rgal ni res mtho res dma'/ rim gyis pa ni rim pas 'char ro// du ma ro gcig rab kyi dus su 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad mnyam pa nyid du rtogs/ snang ba dang sems gcig tu nges don dam pa'i bden par go// mngon par shes pa la sogs pa'ang 'ong*/ rang gi yi dam gyi dngos sam/ smin lam du lung ston pa'ang 'ong*/ phrag dog rtsa ba nas zhi/ ro gcig 'bring gi dus su snang ba dang sems gcig tu nges/ lus dang sems dang snang ba gsum gcig tu 'dres pa'i nyams kyang skye/ snang ba nyid kyang 'di na rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad snang kyang tshur ro gcig go// de bzhin du rgya mtsho chen po ro gcig pa bzhin du sems nyid kyi ngang 'ba' zhig tu thim/ phyi rol gyi gdul bya rnams la mos gus can phan pa dang gnod pa mi mthun par bltas na yang 'byung*/ sgom 'di bas lhag pa med snyam pa yang 'byung*/ de'i dus su sems can yang rang*/ bla ma yang rang snying rje bya ba med mnyam pa'i bdud 'ong dogs yod/ bla ma la mos gus bya ba logs na med rang gi sems su 'dug snyam pa'ang 'ong*/ de la dgongs nas bla ma rin po ches kyang*/

gzhan phan gyi snying rje zhen med 'di// thabs kyis mchog tu tsir gyis bzung*// ces pa dang*/ rang sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang rdo rje slob dpon mi spang*/ zhes pa'o// 'di 'ang bla ma la mos gus byas/ sems can la snying rje bskyed/ dben par bsdad/ 'das ma 'ongs kyi don dran pa spang*/ snang ba la thugs phrad tsam bya/ res tshogs su bsdad/ res dben par bsdad/ phyir la d

ri'am sa bstod dmigs pa la drag tu yang res bsdad/ nang du sems la yang blta/ blta mkhan rang la yang blta/ de ltar byas na mtsho la kha ba babs pa'am/ nags mthug po la me shor ba'am/ dug lnga sman du bsgyur ba'am/ rgya mtsho chen po'i rlabs zhi ba bzhin du rab tu 'gro ba la tshegs med/ ro gcig tha ma ni rang gi lus sems snang ba gsum dbyer mi phyed/ res sems su 'dug pa tsug 'ong*/ res dbyer med byed pa la nges med/ sa la sogs pa sra 'thas can du yang snang*/ phrag dog spong mi nus/ las rgyu 'bras la mi 'dzem/ sngon gyi shes pa dang rang gi shes pa gnyis la khyad med snyam pa yang res 'ong*/ chos byed pa la lkog mi thub/ res mkha' lta tsa na mthar thug 'di rang yin snyam pa'i nyams skye/ bogs 'don par byed pa ni khyad par du yang snang ba la phyir d ri la sogs pa la d steng 'ong bar gsum la yang bsgom/ theg chen rnal 'byor bsgom/ bla ma la mos gus khyad par du bcas/ tshogs bsogs pa'i rigs thams cad bya/ da lta'i ddran pas dran pa rang la ce re gzung*/ mchog tu 'gro ba la tshegs med do// bsgom du med pa la bzhi ste/ rab ni mnyam rjes med pa 'ong ste/ bsgom mi dgos pa'i sgom med do// bsgom pas shes pa rang rtsa ba nas chod pa'i dus su/ sgom khan rang yang ma grub/ sgom yang ma grub pas/ bsgom bya sgom byed dang bral bar go bas yang med das rgyas nas bar do'i snang ba'i dod la gzugs sku gnyis kyi snang ba shar nas sems can gyi don byed pa'o// tshe 'dir 'char ba'i sgom med mthar thug ni/ rang sems sangs rgyas su lhan gyis go nas spang bya spang rgyu med/ gnyen po bsten pa bya rgyu dang bral/ bya sems dang bral/ shi ma shi med snyam pa'i nges shes bting nas go ste mnyam rjes mad kyi don du mthong*/ gang la yang zhen pa med/ gtsang btsog gi rnam par rtog pa chung*/ gsang ba'i gnas bstan kyang ngo tsha rgyu med snyam pa'i sems skye/

dpa' bo mkha' 'gro thams cad kyis mchod pa 'bul zhing*/ sems can gyi don byed pa'i grogs byed/ bdag skye ba gcig gis thogs pa yin ang snyam pa'i nges shes khyad par can skye/ sems can thams cad kyi yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po cher 'gyur ro// bla ma rje btsun thugs rje dang rtogs pa mnyam du 'dres pa'i zhal gyi dkyil 'khor nas yongs ba'i nyams kyi gdams ngag bla ma gong ma rnams kyi snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa dang*/ nyid kyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i nyams myong rnams chu snod gcig nas gcig tu byo ba bzhin du rdo rje 'chang gi rigs kyi rnal 'byor pa thugs kyi rdo rje la snang ba'o// ´/ dge'o/// / 825) ༄// thabs lam gsal ba'i sgron me// na mo ra* gu ru/ chos sku bde chen ngang las ma g.yos kyang*// mos pa'i snang ngor gzugs sku kun la gsal// gang 'dod yid bzhin de don rdzogs par mdzad// bla ma chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo brgyud kun gyi snying po bsdus pa'i don// bla ma rin chen thugs kyi bdud rtsi'i bcud// zhal nas legs gsungs chos drug gdams pa 'di// dran pa gso phyir cung zad yi ger bkod// bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ chos drug rnying ma legs par tshar nas sdod/ chos drug gsar ma 'di mdzad/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ chos drug rnying ma bka'i khrid 'di phyi lus lta bu ma 'di khong pa'i snying lta bu yin gsung*/ de yang snying ma la chos rje sku tshe'i stod la rgyas par gsung ba gcig dang*/ sku tshe'i smad la sku nas su byon pa dang tshogs pa che ba'i stobs kyis dmigs pa dang tshar chos sogs pa thams cad bsdus nas gsungs pas gcig dang gnyis dang po las/ de gnyis gang tshar kyang gsar ma'i khrid bya ru btub gsungs/ de yang dus kyi mi dran dgu dran 'dis 'khor bar byed pa'i sa bon rgyun yin pas na mi dge ba'o// de ltar yang*/

slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'du byed yin// gsung ngo*// 'o na lung ma bstan de gang yin snyam na/ de res lcags srang stong po de la rkyen gser srang gang gis bsgyur na 'gyur la/ ma bsgyur na ni kun gzhi lung ma bstan bya bar gsungs so// de la yid kyi las ni lung ma bstan ces so// lar lung ma bstan bya ba 'gur tung gcig la byed pa yin/ de la kun gzhi dang*/ khams gnyis don gcig pas na/ bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// snying po de la kun gzhi sgras// de bzhin gshegs pas bstan par mdzad// ces so// lar 'di mi la ma 'dri rang gis nyams su long gsungs/ phyi ni gangs dkar gyi rgyal po ti ser gsungs pa de mngon du gyur gsung*/ mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyis// thugs kyi snying po gyur pa kun gzhi tshogs 'khor bka' rgya ma'i ngo sprod/ bka' rgya gsum rim mo/ lho brag khar chu pa le'u phyug tu'o/ ´// 826) ༄// dpal ye shes mgon po'i bstod pa/ hūm̐)/dpal ldan nā leu yi gnas dang sde// stong nyid sgom dang bde mchog rnal 'byor pa// nye bar srung mdzad mgon po bya rog gdong*// bsil ba tshal bzhugs mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod// slob dpon smod cing sangs rgyas bstan la sdang*// rdo rje spun khro sems can yongs la 'tshe// ma nyes log lta gang du 'grogs pa rnams// gtum po khyod kyis tshar chod brlag par mdzod// dam rdzas brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la// thugs dam rgyud bskul bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod// ces pa 'di 'jig rten mgon pos mdzad pa'o// //u yi byang ngos su// gar zha mkha' 'gro'i gnas zhes bya ba yod// khyad du 'phags pa gnas mchog 'gran zla bral// lung pa'i phu ni shar du bstan pa yod// mdo ni nub tu bstan zhing lung pa'i dbyibs// phu ral gnyis bcas mdo dang gsum du yod// dbus su zung 'jug dbu ma chen po'i ri// de la gnyis su med pa'i lha tshogs bzhugs// de rgyab chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs bzhugs// de rgyab mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i skor lam yod// skor lam de nas rim bzhin phyin pa na// lha dang lha mo'i sku dang phyag mtshan yod// thabs shes chu dang dngos grub chu mig yod// 'chi med chu dang yan lag brgyad ldan yod// a li ka li la sogs yig 'bru'i rigs// rang byon lhun grub tshul du bzhugs nas yod// skal ldan bu rnams gnas mchog de ru byon//
